challenges.sol: SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, heure_depart FROM vols WHERE statut = 'Retardé' ORDER BY date_depart, heure_depart, numero_vol;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM passagers WHERE nationalite = 'Française' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT v.numero_vol, a.nom, a.ville FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id WHERE a.pays = 'Espagne' ORDER BY a.ville, v.numero_vol;
SELECT r.id, r.classe, r.prix, v.numero_vol FROM reservations r JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id ORDER BY r.prix DESC, r.id LIMIT 10;

SELECT b.id, p.prenom, p.nom, v.numero_vol FROM bagages b JOIN reservations r ON r.id = b.reservation_id JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE b.statut = 'Perdu' ORDER BY b.id;
SELECT v.numero_vol, v.heure_depart, v.statut FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_depart_id WHERE a.ville = 'Paris' ORDER BY v.heure_depart, v.numero_vol;
SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, p.email FROM passagers p LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT v.numero_vol, v.date_depart, v.statut FROM vols v LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.date_depart, v.numero_vol;
SELECT id, statut, reservation_id FROM bagages WHERE poids_kg IS NULL ORDER BY id;

SELECT DISTINCT p.prenom, p.nom, v.numero_vol FROM reservations r JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE r.classe = 'Affaires' ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom, v.numero_vol;
SELECT modele, immatriculation, capacite FROM avions WHERE capacite > 200 ORDER BY capacite DESC, immatriculation;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM passagers WHERE email LIKE '%.de' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT numero_vol, heure_depart, statut FROM vols WHERE date_depart = '2025-06-13' ORDER BY heure_depart, numero_vol;
SELECT DISTINCT nationalite FROM passagers ORDER BY nationalite;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE classe = 'Affaires';
SELECT id, poids_kg FROM bagages WHERE poids_kg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY poids_kg DESC, id LIMIT 1;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM passagers WHERE date_naissance < '1985-01-01' ORDER BY date_naissance, nom, prenom;
SELECT nom, ville, pays FROM aeroports WHERE pays IN ('Espagne', 'Portugal') ORDER BY ville, nom;
SELECT nom, pays, code FROM compagnies WHERE pays <> 'France' ORDER BY nom;
SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, heure_depart FROM vols WHERE heure_depart < '09:00' ORDER BY date_depart, heure_depart, numero_vol;
SELECT classe, ROUND(AVG(prix), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM reservations GROUP BY classe ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC, classe;
SELECT nationalite, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM passagers GROUP BY nationalite ORDER BY nb DESC, nationalite;
SELECT SUM(poids_kg) FROM bagages;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT passager_id) FROM reservations;
SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, statut FROM vols WHERE statut = 'Retardé' OR statut = 'Annulé' ORDER BY numero_vol;
SELECT modele, immatriculation, capacite FROM avions WHERE modele NOT LIKE 'Airbus%' ORDER BY immatriculation;
SELECT prenom || ' ' || nom AS voyageur FROM passagers WHERE nationalite = 'Japonaise' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM passagers WHERE strftime('%Y', date_naissance) = '1990' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT id, prix FROM reservations ORDER BY prix DESC, id LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1;
SELECT statut, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM vols GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb DESC, statut;
SELECT nationalite, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM passagers GROUP BY nationalite HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY nb DESC, nationalite;
SELECT SUM(capacite) FROM avions;
SELECT statut, COUNT(*) AS nb_bagages FROM bagages GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb_bagages DESC, statut;

SELECT v.numero_vol, v.date_depart, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, v.date_depart ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, v.numero_vol;
SELECT c.nom, SUM(r.prix) AS chiffre_affaires FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC;

SELECT a.ville, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY a.ville ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, a.ville LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.id, v.numero_vol, r.prix FROM reservations r JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE r.classe = 'Économique' AND r.prix > (SELECT AVG(prix) FROM reservations WHERE classe = 'Économique') ORDER BY r.prix DESC, r.id;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT r.vol_id) AS nb_vols FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.vol_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_vols DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom FROM passagers p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r WHERE r.passager_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r JOIN bagages b ON b.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.passager_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT v.numero_vol, c.nom, a.ville, v.statut FROM vols v JOIN compagnies c ON c.id = v.compagnie_id JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.date_depart, v.numero_vol;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, SUM(r.prix) AS total_depense FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING SUM(r.prix) > 500 ORDER BY total_depense DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT v.numero_vol, av.capacite, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacite, 1) AS taux_pct FROM vols v JOIN avions av ON av.id = v.avion_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, av.capacite HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacite > 3 ORDER BY taux_pct DESC, v.numero_vol;

SELECT c.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT v.aeroport_arrivee_id) AS nb_destinations FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.aeroport_arrivee_id) >= 3 ORDER BY nb_destinations DESC, c.nom;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT r.classe) AS nb_classes FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.classe) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_classes DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_reservation) AS mois, classe, COUNT(*) AS nb_reservations, ROUND(AVG(prix), 0) AS prix_moyen FROM reservations GROUP BY mois, classe ORDER BY mois, classe;

SELECT v.numero_vol, a.ville, COUNT(DISTINCT p.nationalite) AS nb_nationalites, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, a.ville HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.nationalite) >= 3 ORDER BY nb_nationalites DESC, nb_reservations DESC, v.numero_vol;

SELECT c.nom, SUM(CASE WHEN r.classe = 'Économique' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_economique, SUM(CASE WHEN r.classe = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_premium, SUM(CASE WHEN r.classe = 'Affaires' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_affaires FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY nb_economique DESC, c.nom;

SELECT c.nom AS compagnie, COUNT(DISTINCT r.passager_id) AS nb_passagers FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY nb_passagers DESC, c.nom;

SELECT a.ville, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC) AS rang FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY a.ville ORDER BY rang, a.ville;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT p.id, p.prenom, p.nom, COALESCE(SUM(r.prix), 0) AS total FROM passagers p LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom), moyenne AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS valeur FROM totaux) SELECT t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(t.total - m.valeur, 2) AS ecart_moyenne FROM totaux t CROSS JOIN moyenne m WHERE t.total > m.valeur ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;

SELECT v.numero_vol, av.capacite, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacite, 1) AS taux_pct FROM vols v JOIN avions av ON av.id = v.avion_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, av.capacite ORDER BY taux_pct DESC, v.numero_vol;

SELECT v.numero_vol, COALESCE(SUM(r.prix), 0) AS chiffre_affaires, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.prix), 0) DESC) AS rang FROM vols v JOIN compagnies c ON c.id = v.compagnie_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id WHERE c.nom = 'AlphaJet' GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol ORDER BY rang, v.numero_vol;

WITH historique AS (SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, v.numero_vol, r.date_reservation, r.prix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.date_reservation, r.id) AS numero_etape, LAG(r.prix) OVER (ORDER BY r.date_reservation, r.id) AS prix_precedent FROM reservations r JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE p.prenom = 'Oliver' AND p.nom = 'Smith') SELECT numero_etape, numero_vol, date_reservation, prix, prix_precedent, prix - prix_precedent AS difference FROM historique ORDER BY date_reservation, reservation_id;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT v.compagnie_id) AS nb_compagnies, COUNT(DISTINCT r.vol_id) AS nb_vols FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.compagnie_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_compagnies DESC, nb_vols DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;

WITH stats AS (SELECT v.id AS vol_id, v.numero_vol, v.compagnie_id, c.nom AS compagnie, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v JOIN compagnies c ON c.id = v.compagnie_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, v.compagnie_id, c.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT compagnie_id, AVG(nb_reservations) AS moyenne FROM stats GROUP BY compagnie_id) SELECT s.numero_vol, s.compagnie, s.nb_reservations, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_compagnie FROM stats s JOIN moyennes m ON m.compagnie_id = s.compagnie_id WHERE s.nb_reservations > m.moyenne ORDER BY s.compagnie, s.nb_reservations DESC, s.numero_vol;

SELECT c.nom AS compagnie, r.classe, SUM(r.prix) AS chiffre_affaires, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(r.prix) DESC) AS rang_classe FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom, r.classe ORDER BY c.nom, rang_classe, r.classe;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, v.numero_vol, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM reservations r JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom, v.id, v.numero_vol HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 1 ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, p.nom, p.prenom, v.numero_vol;
SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, h.date_debut FROM hospitalisations h JOIN patients p ON p.id = h.patient_id WHERE h.date_fin IS NULL ORDER BY h.date_debut, h.id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM patients WHERE ville = 'Paris' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT id, date_consultation, duree_min FROM consultations WHERE diagnostic IS NULL ORDER BY date_consultation, id;
SELECT m.prenom, m.nom, m.specialite, m.date_embauche FROM medecins m JOIN services s ON s.id = m.service_id WHERE s.nom = 'Cardiologie' ORDER BY m.nom, m.prenom;
SELECT h.id, p.prenom, p.nom, h.date_debut, h.date_fin FROM hospitalisations h JOIN patients p ON p.id = h.patient_id WHERE h.date_fin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.date_fin, h.id;
SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, p.ville FROM patients p LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT id, dosage, duree_jours FROM prescriptions WHERE medicament = 'Amoxicilline' ORDER BY duree_jours DESC, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM patients WHERE date_naissance > '2000-01-01' ORDER BY date_naissance, id;
SELECT c.id, m.prenom, m.nom, c.date_consultation, c.duree_min FROM consultations c JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id WHERE c.duree_min > 40 ORDER BY c.duree_min DESC, c.id;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, c.date_consultation, m.nom FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id JOIN services s ON s.id = m.service_id WHERE s.nom = 'Neurologie' ORDER BY c.date_consultation, c.id;

SELECT m.prenom, m.nom, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations FROM medecins m LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.prenom, m.nom ORDER BY nb_consultations DESC, m.nom, m.prenom;

SELECT s.nom, ROUND(AVG(julianday(h.date_fin) - julianday(h.date_debut)), 1) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM services s JOIN hospitalisations h ON h.service_id = s.id WHERE h.date_fin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY duree_moyenne_jours DESC, s.nom;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations, SUM(c.duree_min) AS duree_totale_min FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_consultations DESC, duree_totale_min DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT s.nom, COUNT(m.id) AS nb_medecins FROM services s LEFT JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY nb_medecins DESC, s.nom;
SELECT medicament, COUNT(*) AS nb_prescriptions, ROUND(AVG(duree_jours), 1) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM prescriptions GROUP BY medicament ORDER BY nb_prescriptions DESC, medicament LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, p.ville FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c WHERE c.patient_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hospitalisations h WHERE h.patient_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT c.id, c.date_consultation, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_prescriptions FROM consultations c JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.date_consultation HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_prescriptions DESC, c.id;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT m.service_id) AS nb_services, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.service_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_services DESC, nb_consultations DESC, p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT s.nom, SUM(CASE WHEN c.diagnostic IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sans_diagnostic, COUNT(c.id) AS total_consultations FROM services s JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN c.diagnostic IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY sans_diagnostic DESC, s.nom;
SELECT ville, COUNT(*) AS nb_patients FROM patients GROUP BY ville ORDER BY nb_patients DESC, ville LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.nom AS service, m.prenom, m.nom, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC) AS rang FROM services s JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, m.id, m.prenom, m.nom ORDER BY s.nom, rang, m.nom, m.prenom;

WITH patient_service AS (SELECT s.id AS service_id, s.nom AS service, p.id AS patient_id, p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations FROM services s JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, p.id, p.prenom, p.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT service_id, AVG(nb_consultations) AS moyenne FROM patient_service GROUP BY service_id) SELECT ps.service, ps.prenom, ps.nom, ps.nb_consultations, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_service FROM patient_service ps JOIN moyennes m ON m.service_id = ps.service_id WHERE ps.nb_consultations > m.moyenne ORDER BY ps.service, ps.nb_consultations DESC, ps.nom, ps.prenom;

SELECT c.date_consultation, c.duree_min, LAG(c.duree_min) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_consultation, c.id) AS duree_precedente, c.duree_min - LAG(c.duree_min) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_consultation, c.id) AS difference FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.prenom = 'Camille' AND p.nom = 'Moreau' ORDER BY c.date_consultation, c.id;

SELECT s.nom, s.capacite_lits, COUNT(h.id) AS nb_en_cours, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(h.id) / s.capacite_lits, 1) AS taux_occupation_pct FROM services s LEFT JOIN hospitalisations h ON h.service_id = s.id AND h.date_fin IS NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, s.capacite_lits ORDER BY taux_occupation_pct DESC, s.nom;

WITH services_par_patient AS (SELECT p.id, p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT m.service_id) AS nb_services FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom), moyenne AS (SELECT AVG(nb_services) AS valeur FROM services_par_patient) SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, s.nb_services, ROUND(m.valeur, 2) AS moyenne_globale FROM services_par_patient s CROSS JOIN moyenne m WHERE s.nb_services > m.valeur ORDER BY s.nb_services DESC, s.nom, s.prenom;

SELECT s.nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_prescriptions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC) AS rang FROM services s LEFT JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY rang, s.nom;

WITH prescriptions_medecin AS (SELECT s.id AS service_id, s.nom AS service, m.id AS medecin_id, m.prenom, m.nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_prescriptions FROM services s JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, m.id, m.prenom, m.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT service_id, AVG(nb_prescriptions) AS moyenne FROM prescriptions_medecin GROUP BY service_id) SELECT pm.service, pm.prenom, pm.nom, pm.nb_prescriptions, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_service FROM prescriptions_medecin pm JOIN moyennes m ON m.service_id = pm.service_id WHERE pm.nb_prescriptions > m.moyenne ORDER BY pm.service, pm.nb_prescriptions DESC, pm.nom, pm.prenom;

WITH consultations_services AS (SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.prenom, p.nom, c.date_consultation, c.id AS consultation_id, s.nom AS service, LAG(s.nom) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY c.date_consultation, c.id) AS service_precedent FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id JOIN services s ON s.id = m.service_id) SELECT prenom, nom, date_consultation, service, service_precedent FROM consultations_services WHERE service_precedent IS NOT NULL AND service <> service_precedent ORDER BY nom, prenom, date_consultation, consultation_id;

SELECT s.nom AS service, p.sexe, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_consultations, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC) AS rang FROM services s JOIN medecins m ON m.service_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.medecin_id = m.id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, p.sexe ORDER BY s.nom, rang, p.sexe;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c WHERE c.patient_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c JOIN medecins m ON m.id = c.medecin_id WHERE c.patient_id = p.id AND m.service_id = s.id)) ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT nom, prix FROM plats WHERE disponible = 0 ORDER BY prix DESC, nom;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM clients WHERE date_inscription >= '2024-07-01' AND date_inscription < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT p.nom, p.prix FROM plats p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.categorie_id WHERE c.nom = 'Plats au wok' ORDER BY p.prix, p.nom;
SELECT id, note, client_id FROM avis WHERE commentaire IS NULL ORDER BY note DESC, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_embauche FROM serveurs WHERE date_embauche > '2020-01-01' ORDER BY date_embauche, nom, prenom;
SELECT id, date_commande, heure_commande FROM commandes WHERE statut = 'Annulée' ORDER BY date_commande, heure_commande, id;
SELECT nom, stock, seuil_alerte FROM ingredients WHERE stock < seuil_alerte ORDER BY seuil_alerte - stock, nom;
SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, cl.email FROM clients cl LEFT JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY cl.nom, cl.prenom;
SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, s.date_embauche FROM serveurs s LEFT JOIN commandes c ON c.serveur_id = s.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.nom, s.prenom;
SELECT c.id, c.date_commande, c.statut FROM commandes c LEFT JOIN avis a ON a.commande_id = c.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.date_commande, c.id;

SELECT cat.nom AS categorie, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS chiffre_affaires FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c ON c.id = l.commande_id JOIN plats p ON p.id = l.plat_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.categorie_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.nom ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, cat.nom;
SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_commandes FROM serveurs s LEFT JOIN commandes c ON c.serveur_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC, s.nom, s.prenom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT c.id AS commande_id, c.client_id, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.client_id IS NOT NULL AND c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY c.id, c.client_id) SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS panier_moyen FROM totaux t JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = t.client_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom;

SELECT p.nom, SUM(l.quantite) AS quantite_totale, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS chiffre_affaires FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c ON c.id = l.commande_id JOIN plats p ON p.id = l.plat_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY p.id, p.nom ORDER BY quantite_totale DESC, p.nom LIMIT 5;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total_depense FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom HAVING SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) > 100 ORDER BY total_depense DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom;

SELECT i.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.plat_id) AS nb_plats FROM ingredients i JOIN plats_ingredients pi ON pi.ingredient_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id, i.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pi.plat_id) > 3 ORDER BY nb_plats DESC, i.nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT c.id, c.client_id, c.nb_personnes, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY c.id, c.client_id, c.nb_personnes) SELECT t.id, COALESCE(cl.prenom, 'Anonyme') AS prenom, COALESCE(cl.nom, '') AS nom, t.nb_personnes, t.total FROM totaux t LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = t.client_id WHERE t.total > 50 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.id;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.id) AS nb_categories FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id JOIN plats p ON p.id = l.plat_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.categorie_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cat.id) >= 3 ORDER BY nb_categories DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom;
SELECT note, COUNT(*) AS nb_avis, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM avis), 1) AS pourcentage FROM avis GROUP BY note ORDER BY note DESC;

SELECT p.nom, cat.nom AS categorie, p.prix FROM plats p JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.categorie_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c ON c.id = l.commande_id WHERE l.plat_id = p.id AND c.statut <> 'Annulée') ORDER BY cat.nom, p.nom;

SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS ca_total FROM serveurs s JOIN commandes c ON c.serveur_id = s.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom ORDER BY ca_total DESC, s.nom, s.prenom LIMIT 3;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total_depense, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) DESC) AS rang FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom ORDER BY rang, cl.nom, cl.prenom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT c.id AS commande_id, c.client_id, c.date_commande, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY c.id, c.client_id, c.date_commande) SELECT t.date_commande, t.total, LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.date_commande, t.commande_id) AS total_precedent, t.total - LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.date_commande, t.commande_id) AS difference FROM totaux t JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = t.client_id WHERE cl.prenom = 'Camille' AND cl.nom = 'Moreau' ORDER BY t.date_commande, t.commande_id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom), moyenne AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS valeur FROM totaux) SELECT t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(t.total - m.valeur, 2) AS ecart_moyenne FROM totaux t CROSS JOIN moyenne m WHERE t.total > m.valeur ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;

SELECT cat.nom AS categorie, p.nom AS plat, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS chiffre_affaires, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) DESC) AS rang FROM categories cat JOIN plats p ON p.categorie_id = cat.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.plat_id = p.id JOIN commandes c ON c.id = l.commande_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.nom, p.id, p.nom ORDER BY cat.nom, rang, p.nom;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', c.date_commande)) AS nb_mois FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' AND c.date_commande >= '2024-01-01' AND c.date_commande < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', c.date_commande)) >= 3 ORDER BY cl.nom, cl.prenom;

WITH ventes AS (SELECT cat.id AS categorie_id, cat.nom AS categorie, p.id AS plat_id, p.nom AS plat, SUM(l.quantite) AS quantite FROM categories cat JOIN plats p ON p.categorie_id = cat.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.plat_id = p.id JOIN commandes c ON c.id = l.commande_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.nom, p.id, p.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT categorie_id, AVG(quantite) AS moyenne FROM ventes GROUP BY categorie_id) SELECT v.categorie, v.plat, v.quantite, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_categorie FROM ventes v JOIN moyennes m ON m.categorie_id = v.categorie_id WHERE v.quantite > m.moyenne ORDER BY v.categorie, v.quantite DESC, v.plat;

SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire), 0) AS ca_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire), 0) DESC) AS rang FROM serveurs s LEFT JOIN commandes c ON c.serveur_id = s.id AND c.statut <> 'Annulée' LEFT JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom ORDER BY rang, s.nom, s.prenom;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, p.nom AS plat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS nb_commandes FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id JOIN plats p ON p.id = l.plat_id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, p.id, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom, p.nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, substr(cl.email, -2) AS domaine, SUM(l.quantite * l.prix_unitaire) AS total FROM clients cl JOIN commandes c ON c.client_id = cl.id JOIN lignes_commande l ON l.commande_id = c.id WHERE c.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, substr(cl.email, -2)), moyennes AS (SELECT domaine, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY domaine) SELECT t.domaine, t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_domaine FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.domaine = t.domaine WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.domaine, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;
SELECT nom, type_pate, prix_kg FROM fromages WHERE disponible = 1 ORDER BY prix_kg, nom;
SELECT nom, region, pays FROM producteurs ORDER BY region, nom;
SELECT nom, prix_kg FROM fromages WHERE type_pate = 'Pâte persillée' ORDER BY prix_kg DESC, nom;
SELECT prenom, nom, ville FROM clients WHERE ville = 'Paris' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT id, date_vente, prix_total FROM ventes WHERE prix_total > 15 ORDER BY date_vente DESC, id;
SELECT client_id, fromage_id, note FROM degustations WHERE note >= 4 ORDER BY note DESC, fromage_id, client_id;
SELECT numero_lot, poids_kg, date_production FROM lots WHERE poids_kg >= 3 ORDER BY poids_kg DESC, numero_lot;
SELECT id, date_vente, prix_total FROM ventes WHERE date_vente >= '2024-10-01' ORDER BY date_vente, id;
SELECT DISTINCT type_pate FROM fromages ORDER BY type_pate;
SELECT c.id, c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_ventes FROM clients c LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY nb_ventes DESC, c.nom, c.prenom, c.id;

SELECT p.region, ROUND(SUM(v.prix_total), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM ventes v JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id JOIN fromages f ON f.id = l.fromage_id JOIN producteurs p ON p.id = f.producteur_id GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, p.region;
SELECT f.nom, ROUND(AVG(d.note), 2) AS note_moyenne FROM fromages f JOIN degustations d ON d.fromage_id = f.id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom HAVING AVG(d.note) > 4 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC, f.nom;
SELECT p.nom, COUNT(f.id) AS nb_fromages FROM producteurs p JOIN fromages f ON f.producteur_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.nom HAVING COUNT(f.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_fromages DESC, p.nom;
SELECT f.nom, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_ventes FROM fromages f JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_ventes DESC, f.nom;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, ROUND(SUM(v.prix_total), 2) AS total_depense FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING SUM(v.prix_total) > 50 ORDER BY total_depense DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT id, date_vente, prix_total FROM ventes WHERE prix_total > (SELECT AVG(prix_total) FROM ventes) ORDER BY prix_total DESC, id;

SELECT f.type_pate, ROUND(SUM(v.quantite_kg), 2) AS poids_vendu, ROUND(SUM(v.prix_total), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM fromages f JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY f.type_pate ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, f.type_pate;
SELECT p.nom, COUNT(f.id) AS nb_fromages FROM producteurs p LEFT JOIN fromages f ON f.producteur_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.nom ORDER BY p.nom, p.id;
SELECT f.id, f.nom FROM fromages f LEFT JOIN degustations d ON d.fromage_id = f.id WHERE d.id IS NULL ORDER BY f.id;
SELECT note, COUNT(*) AS nb_degustations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM degustations), 1) AS pourcentage FROM degustations GROUP BY note ORDER BY note DESC;

WITH ca AS (SELECT p.region, f.id, f.nom, SUM(v.prix_total) AS chiffre_affaires FROM producteurs p JOIN fromages f ON f.producteur_id = p.id JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY p.region, f.id, f.nom), classement AS (SELECT region, nom, chiffre_affaires, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC) AS rang FROM ca) SELECT region, nom, ROUND(chiffre_affaires, 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM classement WHERE rang = 1 ORDER BY region, chiffre_affaires DESC, nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT c.id, c.prenom, c.nom, c.ville, SUM(v.prix_total) AS total FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom, c.ville), moyennes AS (SELECT ville, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY ville) SELECT t.ville, t.prenom, t.nom, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total_depense, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_ville FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.ville = t.ville WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.ville, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;

WITH ca AS (SELECT f.id, f.nom, SUM(v.prix_total) AS total FROM fromages f JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom) SELECT nom, ROUND(total, 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM ca WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM ca) ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT p.id, p.nom, SUM(v.prix_total) AS chiffre_affaires FROM producteurs p JOIN fromages f ON f.producteur_id = p.id JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.nom) SELECT nom, ROUND(chiffre_affaires, 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM totaux WHERE chiffre_affaires > (SELECT AVG(chiffre_affaires) FROM totaux) ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, nom;

SELECT f.nom, ROUND(SUM(v.quantite_kg), 2) AS quantite_vendue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.quantite_kg) DESC) AS rang FROM fromages f JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom ORDER BY rang, f.nom;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id JOIN fromages f ON f.id = l.fromage_id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.type_pate) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT type_pate) FROM fromages) ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, f.nom AS fromage, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS nb_ventes FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id JOIN fromages f ON f.id = l.fromage_id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom, f.id, f.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_ventes DESC, c.nom, c.prenom, f.nom;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN f.id END) AS fromages_vendus FROM fromages f LEFT JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT f.type_pate) AS nb_types FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id JOIN fromages f ON f.id = l.fromage_id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.type_pate) > 2 ORDER BY nb_types DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

WITH prix AS (SELECT f.id, f.nom, SUM(v.prix_total) / SUM(v.quantite_kg) AS prix_moyen_kg FROM fromages f JOIN lots l ON l.fromage_id = f.id JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom) SELECT nom, ROUND(prix_moyen_kg, 2) AS prix_moyen_kg FROM prix WHERE prix_moyen_kg > (SELECT SUM(prix_total) / SUM(quantite_kg) FROM ventes) ORDER BY prix_moyen_kg DESC, nom;
SELECT id, date_reservation, statut FROM reservations WHERE statut = 'Annulée' ORDER BY date_reservation, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM clients WHERE ville = 'Lyon' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT c.nom AS circuit, d.pays, c.prix_base FROM circuits c JOIN destinations d ON d.id = c.destination_id WHERE d.continent = 'Asie' ORDER BY c.prix_base, c.nom;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_embauche FROM guides WHERE langue = 'Français' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT id, montant, date_paiement FROM paiements WHERE statut = 'En attente' ORDER BY montant DESC, id;
SELECT nom, duree_jours, prix_base FROM circuits WHERE duree_jours > 10 ORDER BY duree_jours DESC, nom;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, c.ville FROM clients c LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT g.prenom, g.nom, g.langue FROM guides g LEFT JOIN affectations_guides a ON a.guide_id = g.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY g.nom, g.prenom;
SELECT id, note, client_id FROM avis WHERE commentaire IS NULL ORDER BY note DESC, id;

SELECT c.nom AS circuit, d.nom AS destination, c.prix_base FROM circuits c JOIN destinations d ON d.id = c.destination_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.circuit_id = c.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.prix_base DESC, c.nom;

SELECT d.nom AS destination, ROUND(SUM(p.montant), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM paiements p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = r.circuit_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY d.id, d.nom ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, d.nom;
SELECT c.nom AS circuit, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.circuit_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, c.nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.client_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.montant), 0) AS total FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id AND p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY r.id, r.client_id) SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS panier_moyen FROM totaux t JOIN clients c ON c.id = t.client_id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

WITH par_reservation AS (SELECT r.id, r.circuit_id, r.nb_personnes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.statut = 'Payé' THEN p.montant ELSE 0 END), 0) AS chiffre_affaires FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.statut <> 'Annulée' GROUP BY r.id, r.circuit_id, r.nb_personnes) SELECT c.nom AS circuit, SUM(pr.nb_personnes) AS nb_personnes, ROUND(SUM(pr.chiffre_affaires), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM par_reservation pr JOIN circuits c ON c.id = pr.circuit_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY nb_personnes DESC, chiffre_affaires DESC, c.nom LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, ROUND(SUM(p.montant), 2) AS total_depense FROM clients c JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING SUM(p.montant) > 3000 ORDER BY total_depense DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT g.prenom, g.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT a.circuit_id) AS nb_circuits FROM guides g JOIN affectations_guides a ON a.guide_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, g.prenom, g.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.circuit_id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_circuits DESC, g.nom, g.prenom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT r.id, r.client_id, r.circuit_id, SUM(p.montant) AS total FROM reservations r JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY r.id, r.client_id, r.circuit_id) SELECT t.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, ci.nom AS circuit, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total FROM totaux t JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = t.client_id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = t.circuit_id WHERE t.total > 5000 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.id;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS nb_destinations FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = r.circuit_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_destinations DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom;
SELECT note, COUNT(*) AS nb_avis, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM avis), 1) AS pourcentage FROM avis GROUP BY note ORDER BY note DESC;

SELECT ci.nom AS circuit, d.nom AS destination, ci.prix_base FROM circuits ci JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id LEFT JOIN avis a ON a.circuit_id = ci.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY ci.prix_base DESC, ci.nom;

SELECT d.nom AS destination, d.pays, ROUND(SUM(p.montant), 2) AS ca_total FROM paiements p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = r.circuit_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY d.id, d.nom, d.pays ORDER BY ca_total DESC, d.nom LIMIT 3;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(p.montant) AS total_depense, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.montant) DESC) AS rang FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom ORDER BY rang, cl.nom, cl.prenom, cl.id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT r.id, r.client_id, r.date_reservation, SUM(p.montant) AS total FROM reservations r JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY r.id, r.client_id, r.date_reservation) SELECT t.date_reservation, t.total, LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.date_reservation, t.id) AS total_precedent, t.total - LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.date_reservation, t.id) AS difference FROM totaux t JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = t.client_id WHERE cl.prenom = 'Camille' AND cl.nom = 'Moreau' ORDER BY t.date_reservation, t.id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(p.montant) AS total FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom) SELECT prenom, nom, ROUND(total, 2) AS total_depense, ROUND(total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM totaux), 2) AS ecart_moyenne FROM totaux WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM totaux) ORDER BY total DESC, nom, prenom;

SELECT d.nom AS destination, ci.nom AS circuit, SUM(p.montant) AS ca, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY SUM(p.montant) DESC) AS rang FROM destinations d JOIN circuits ci ON ci.destination_id = d.id JOIN reservations r ON r.circuit_id = ci.id JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY d.id, d.nom, ci.id, ci.nom ORDER BY d.nom, rang, ci.nom;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT d.continent) AS nb_continents FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = r.circuit_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.continent) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT continent) FROM destinations) ORDER BY cl.nom, cl.prenom;

WITH volumes AS (SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.nom AS destination, ci.id AS circuit_id, ci.nom AS circuit, SUM(r.nb_personnes) AS nb_personnes FROM destinations d JOIN circuits ci ON ci.destination_id = d.id JOIN reservations r ON r.circuit_id = ci.id GROUP BY d.id, d.nom, ci.id, ci.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT destination_id, AVG(nb_personnes) AS moyenne FROM volumes GROUP BY destination_id) SELECT v.destination, v.circuit, v.nb_personnes, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_destination FROM volumes v JOIN moyennes m ON m.destination_id = v.destination_id WHERE v.nb_personnes > m.moyenne ORDER BY v.destination, v.nb_personnes DESC, v.circuit;

SELECT g.prenom, g.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT a.circuit_id) AS nb_circuits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.circuit_id) DESC) AS rang FROM guides g LEFT JOIN affectations_guides a ON a.guide_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, g.prenom, g.nom ORDER BY rang, g.nom, g.prenom;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom, ci.nom AS circuit, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN circuits ci ON ci.id = r.circuit_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.prenom, cl.nom, ci.id, ci.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, cl.nom, cl.prenom, ci.nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.ville, cl.prenom, cl.nom, SUM(p.montant) AS total FROM clients cl JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = cl.id JOIN paiements p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE p.statut = 'Payé' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.ville, cl.prenom, cl.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT ville, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY ville) SELECT t.ville, t.prenom, t.nom, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total_depense, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_ville FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.ville = t.ville WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.ville, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;
SELECT titre, date_debut, budget FROM projets WHERE date_fin IS NULL ORDER BY date_debut, titre;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_embauche FROM chercheurs WHERE grade = 'Directeur' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT nom, date_experience, duree_heures FROM experiences WHERE statut = 'Planifiée' ORDER BY date_experience, nom;
SELECT r.id, r.mesure, e.nom AS experience FROM resultats r JOIN experiences e ON e.id = r.experience_id WHERE r.valeur IS NULL ORDER BY r.id;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, c.grade FROM chercheurs c JOIN equipes e ON e.id = c.equipe_id WHERE e.domaine = 'Biologie' ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT titre, revue, projet_id FROM publications WHERE date_publication IS NULL ORDER BY titre;
SELECT code_echantillon, quantite_mg, date_prelevement FROM echantillons WHERE type_echantillon = 'Sang' ORDER BY date_prelevement, code_echantillon;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, c.grade FROM chercheurs c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affectations_chercheurs a JOIN publications pub ON pub.projet_id = a.projet_id WHERE a.chercheur_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT titre, budget, statut FROM projets WHERE budget > 300000 ORDER BY budget DESC, titre;

SELECT e.nom AS experience, e.statut, p.titre AS projet FROM experiences e JOIN projets p ON p.id = e.projet_id LEFT JOIN echantillons s ON s.experience_id = e.id WHERE s.id IS NULL ORDER BY e.nom, e.id;
SELECT p.titre, COUNT(e.id) AS nb_experiences FROM projets p LEFT JOIN experiences e ON e.projet_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.titre ORDER BY nb_experiences DESC, p.titre;
SELECT e.nom AS equipe, SUM(p.budget) AS budget_total FROM equipes e JOIN projets p ON p.equipe_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom ORDER BY budget_total DESC, e.nom;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(e.id) AS nb_experiences FROM chercheurs c JOIN experiences e ON e.chercheur_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_experiences DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT e.nom AS equipe, COUNT(DISTINCT pub.id) AS nb_publications FROM equipes e LEFT JOIN projets p ON p.equipe_id = e.id LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.projet_id = p.id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom ORDER BY nb_publications DESC, e.nom;
SELECT p.titre, p.budget, p.statut FROM projets p LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.projet_id = p.id WHERE pub.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.budget DESC, p.titre;
SELECT type_echantillon, COUNT(*) AS nb_echantillons, SUM(quantite_mg) AS quantite_totale FROM echantillons GROUP BY type_echantillon ORDER BY nb_echantillons DESC, type_echantillon;

SELECT p.titre, COUNT(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.valide = 1) AS nb_valides FROM projets p LEFT JOIN experiences e ON e.projet_id = p.id LEFT JOIN resultats r ON r.experience_id = e.id GROUP BY p.id, p.titre ORDER BY nb_valides DESC, p.titre;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT a.projet_id) AS nb_projets FROM chercheurs c JOIN affectations_chercheurs a ON a.chercheur_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.projet_id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_projets DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT CASE WHEN valide = 1 THEN 'Validé' ELSE 'En attente' END AS statut_validation, COUNT(*) AS nb_resultats, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resultats), 1) AS pourcentage FROM resultats GROUP BY statut_validation ORDER BY nb_resultats DESC, statut_validation;

WITH stats AS (SELECT e.id AS equipe_id, e.nom AS equipe, p.id AS projet_id, p.titre, p.budget FROM equipes e JOIN projets p ON p.equipe_id = e.id), moyennes AS (SELECT equipe_id, AVG(budget) AS moyenne FROM stats GROUP BY equipe_id) SELECT s.equipe, s.titre, s.budget, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_equipe FROM stats s JOIN moyennes m ON m.equipe_id = s.equipe_id WHERE s.budget > m.moyenne ORDER BY s.equipe, s.budget DESC, s.titre;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(e.id) AS nb_experiences FROM chercheurs c JOIN experiences e ON e.chercheur_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY nb_experiences DESC, c.nom, c.prenom LIMIT 5;
SELECT titre, budget, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY budget DESC) AS rang FROM projets ORDER BY rang, titre;

SELECT e.date_experience, e.duree_heures, LAG(e.duree_heures) OVER (ORDER BY e.date_experience, e.id) AS duree_precedente, e.duree_heures - LAG(e.duree_heures) OVER (ORDER BY e.date_experience, e.id) AS difference FROM experiences e JOIN chercheurs c ON c.id = e.chercheur_id WHERE c.prenom = 'Sophie' AND c.nom = 'Martin' ORDER BY e.date_experience, e.id;

WITH budgets AS (SELECT e.id AS equipe_id, e.nom AS equipe, c.id AS chercheur_id, c.prenom, c.nom, SUM(p.budget) AS budget_total FROM equipes e JOIN chercheurs c ON c.equipe_id = e.id JOIN affectations_chercheurs a ON a.chercheur_id = c.id JOIN projets p ON p.id = a.projet_id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom, c.id, c.prenom, c.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT equipe_id, AVG(budget_total) AS moyenne FROM budgets GROUP BY equipe_id) SELECT b.equipe, b.prenom, b.nom, b.budget_total, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_equipe FROM budgets b JOIN moyennes m ON m.equipe_id = b.equipe_id WHERE b.budget_total > m.moyenne ORDER BY b.equipe, b.budget_total DESC, b.nom, b.prenom;

SELECT p.titre, COUNT(pub.id) AS nb_publications, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(pub.id) DESC) AS rang FROM projets p LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.projet_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.titre ORDER BY rang, p.titre;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom FROM chercheurs c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publications team_pub JOIN projets team_p ON team_p.id = team_pub.projet_id WHERE team_p.equipe_id = c.equipe_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affectations_chercheurs a WHERE a.chercheur_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publications pub JOIN projets p ON p.id = pub.projet_id WHERE p.equipe_id = c.equipe_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affectations_chercheurs a2 JOIN publications pub2 ON pub2.projet_id = a2.projet_id WHERE a2.chercheur_id = c.id AND pub2.revue = pub.revue)) ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT e.nom AS equipe, p.titre, p.date_debut, p.budget, SUM(p.budget) OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY p.date_debut, p.id) AS budget_cumule FROM projets p JOIN equipes e ON e.id = p.equipe_id ORDER BY e.nom, p.date_debut;

SELECT equipe, titre, date_debut FROM (SELECT e.nom AS equipe, p.titre, p.date_debut, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY p.date_debut, p.id) AS rn FROM equipes e JOIN projets p ON p.equipe_id = e.id) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY date_debut;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT e.projet_id) AS nb_projets FROM chercheurs c JOIN experiences e ON e.chercheur_id = c.id JOIN resultats r ON r.experience_id = e.id WHERE r.valide = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.projet_id) > 1 ORDER BY nb_projets DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT projet, experience, duree_heures FROM (SELECT p.titre AS projet, x.nom AS experience, x.duree_heures, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY x.duree_heures DESC) AS rg FROM projets p JOIN experiences x ON x.projet_id = p.id) WHERE rg = 1 ORDER BY projet, experience;

SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclos_id) AS nb_enclos, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclos_id) DESC) AS rang FROM soigneurs s LEFT JOIN affectations_soigneurs a ON a.soigneur_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom ORDER BY rang, s.nom, s.prenom, s.id;

SELECT a.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT r.type_repas) AS nb_types, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_repas FROM animaux a JOIN repas r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.type_repas) > 1 ORDER BY nb_types DESC, a.nom, a.id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT v.id, v.ville, v.prenom, v.nom, COALESCE(SUM(b.prix), 0) AS total FROM visiteurs v LEFT JOIN billets b ON b.visiteur_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.ville, v.prenom, v.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT ville, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY ville) SELECT t.ville, t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_ville FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.ville = t.ville WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.ville, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom;
SELECT nom, sexe, date_arrivee FROM animaux WHERE poids_kg IS NULL ORDER BY date_arrivee, nom, id;

SELECT a.nom, en.nom AS enclos, a.date_naissance FROM animaux a JOIN especes e ON e.id = a.espece_id JOIN enclos en ON en.id = a.enclos_id WHERE e.nom_commun = 'Lion' ORDER BY a.date_naissance, a.nom, a.id;
SELECT nom, surface_m2, capacite FROM enclos WHERE type = 'Savane' ORDER BY surface_m2 DESC, nom, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_embauche FROM soigneurs WHERE specialite = 'Reptiles' ORDER BY nom, prenom, id;
SELECT id, date_repas, heure_repas, quantite_kg FROM repas WHERE soigneur_id IS NULL ORDER BY date_repas, heure_repas, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM visiteurs WHERE ville = 'Paris' ORDER BY nom, prenom, id;
SELECT id, date_visite, prix FROM billets WHERE type_billet = 'Famille' ORDER BY date_visite, id;
SELECT v.prenom, v.nom, v.email FROM visiteurs v LEFT JOIN billets b ON b.visiteur_id = v.id WHERE b.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.nom, v.prenom, v.id;
SELECT id, note, visiteur_id FROM avis WHERE commentaire IS NULL ORDER BY note DESC, id;
SELECT a.nom, e.nom_commun, a.poids_kg FROM animaux a JOIN especes e ON e.id = a.espece_id JOIN enclos en ON en.id = a.enclos_id WHERE en.nom = 'Plaine africaine' ORDER BY a.nom, a.id;
SELECT en.nom, en.capacite, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux FROM enclos en LEFT JOIN animaux a ON a.enclos_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.nom, en.capacite ORDER BY nb_animaux DESC, en.nom, en.id;
SELECT a.nom, SUM(r.quantite_kg) AS quantite_totale, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_repas FROM animaux a JOIN repas r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.nom ORDER BY quantite_totale DESC, a.nom, a.id;
SELECT type_billet, COUNT(*) AS nb_billets, SUM(prix) AS chiffre_affaires FROM billets GROUP BY type_billet ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, type_billet;

SELECT s.prenom, s.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclos_id) AS nb_enclos FROM soigneurs s LEFT JOIN affectations_soigneurs a ON a.soigneur_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom ORDER BY nb_enclos DESC, s.nom, s.prenom, s.id;
SELECT a.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_repas FROM animaux a JOIN repas r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.nom HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 1 ORDER BY nb_repas DESC, a.nom, a.id;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_visite) AS mois, type_billet, COUNT(*) AS nb_billets FROM billets GROUP BY mois, type_billet ORDER BY mois, type_billet;

SELECT v.prenom, v.nom, ROUND(AVG(a.note), 2) AS note_moyenne FROM visiteurs v JOIN avis a ON a.visiteur_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.prenom, v.nom HAVING AVG(a.note) > 4 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC, v.nom, v.prenom, v.id;

SELECT en.nom, en.capacite, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux FROM enclos en JOIN animaux a ON a.enclos_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.nom, en.capacite HAVING en.capacite - COUNT(a.id) <= 4 ORDER BY en.capacite - COUNT(a.id), en.nom, en.id;

SELECT a.nom, e.nom_commun, en.nom AS enclos FROM animaux a JOIN especes e ON e.id = a.espece_id JOIN enclos en ON en.id = a.enclos_id LEFT JOIN repas r ON r.animal_id = a.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.nom, a.id;
SELECT note, COUNT(*) AS nb_avis, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM avis), 1) AS pourcentage FROM avis GROUP BY note ORDER BY note DESC;
SELECT en.nom, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux FROM enclos en LEFT JOIN animaux a ON a.enclos_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.nom ORDER BY nb_animaux DESC, en.nom, en.id LIMIT 3;

SELECT en.nom, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC) AS rang FROM enclos en LEFT JOIN animaux a ON a.enclos_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.nom ORDER BY rang, en.nom, en.id;

SELECT r.date_repas, r.quantite_kg, LAG(r.quantite_kg) OVER (ORDER BY r.date_repas, r.heure_repas, r.id) AS quantite_precedente, r.quantite_kg - LAG(r.quantite_kg) OVER (ORDER BY r.date_repas, r.heure_repas, r.id) AS difference FROM repas r JOIN animaux a ON a.id = r.animal_id WHERE a.nom = 'Simba' ORDER BY r.date_repas, r.heure_repas, r.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT s.id, s.prenom, s.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_repas FROM soigneurs s LEFT JOIN repas r ON r.soigneur_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.prenom, s.nom) SELECT prenom, nom, nb_repas, ROUND((SELECT AVG(nb_repas) FROM stats), 2) AS moyenne_globale FROM stats WHERE nb_repas > (SELECT AVG(nb_repas) FROM stats) ORDER BY nb_repas DESC, nom, prenom, id;

SELECT e.nom_commun, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC) AS rang FROM especes e LEFT JOIN animaux a ON a.espece_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom_commun ORDER BY rang, e.nom_commun, e.id;

SELECT v.prenom, v.nom FROM visiteurs v WHERE NOT (v.prenom = 'Manon' AND v.nom = 'Lambert') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billets r JOIN visiteurs ref ON ref.id = r.visiteur_id WHERE ref.prenom = 'Manon' AND ref.nom = 'Lambert' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billets b WHERE b.visiteur_id = v.id AND b.type_billet = r.type_billet)) ORDER BY v.nom, v.prenom, v.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT en.id, en.nom, en.type, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_animaux FROM enclos en LEFT JOIN animaux a ON a.enclos_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.nom, en.type), moyennes AS (SELECT type, AVG(nb_animaux) AS moyenne FROM stats GROUP BY type) SELECT s.type, s.nom, s.nb_animaux, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_type FROM stats s JOIN moyennes m ON m.type = s.type WHERE s.nb_animaux > m.moyenne ORDER BY s.type, s.nb_animaux DESC, s.nom, s.id;
SELECT a.prenom, a.nom FROM adherents a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM abonnements ab WHERE ab.adherent_id = a.id AND ab.date_fin IS NULL) ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_embauche FROM coachs WHERE specialite = 'Yoga' ORDER BY nom, prenom, id;
SELECT nom, capacite_max, duree_min, niveau FROM cours WHERE capacite_max > 15 ORDER BY capacite_max DESC, nom, id;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, c.specialite FROM coachs c LEFT JOIN cours co ON co.coach_id = c.id WHERE co.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom, c.id;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM adherents WHERE date_naissance > '2000-01-01' ORDER BY date_naissance, nom, prenom, id;
SELECT nom, surface_m2, type FROM salles WHERE type = 'Cours collectifs' ORDER BY surface_m2 DESC, nom, id;
SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, a.email FROM adherents a LEFT JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id WHERE i.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;
SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, ab.type, ab.prix FROM abonnements ab JOIN adherents a ON a.id = ab.adherent_id WHERE ab.date_fin IS NULL ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, ab.type, ab.id;
SELECT nom, duree_min, capacite_max FROM cours WHERE niveau = 'Avancé' ORDER BY duree_min DESC, nom, id;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom FROM adherents a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inscriptions_cours i JOIN planning p ON p.id = i.planning_id WHERE i.adherent_id = a.id AND p.jour_semaine = 'Lundi') ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;

SELECT c.nom, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscriptions FROM cours c LEFT JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id LEFT JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY nb_inscriptions DESC, c.nom, c.id;
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS nb_abonnements, SUM(prix) AS recette FROM abonnements GROUP BY type ORDER BY recette DESC, type;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT i.planning_id) AS nb_creneaux FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.planning_id) > 2 ORDER BY nb_creneaux DESC, a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;

SELECT c.nom, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits, SUM(CASE WHEN i.presence THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_presents, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.presence THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id), 1) AS taux_presence_pct FROM cours c JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY taux_presence_pct DESC, c.nom, c.id;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) AS nb_cours FROM coachs c LEFT JOIN cours co ON co.coach_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY nb_cours DESC, c.nom, c.prenom, c.id;

SELECT c.nom, p.jour_semaine, p.heure_debut, c.capacite_max, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits FROM cours c JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, c.id, c.nom, p.jour_semaine, p.heure_debut, c.capacite_max HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= c.capacite_max ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) - c.capacite_max DESC, c.nom, p.jour_semaine, p.heure_debut, p.id;
SELECT type, COUNT(DISTINCT adherent_id) AS nb_adherents FROM abonnements WHERE date_fin IS NULL GROUP BY type ORDER BY nb_adherents DESC, type;

SELECT DISTINCT a.prenom, a.nom FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id JOIN planning p ON p.id = i.planning_id JOIN cours c ON c.id = p.cours_id WHERE c.nom LIKE '%Yoga%' AND i.presence = TRUE ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom;

SELECT c.nom, p.jour_semaine, p.heure_debut FROM cours c JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id LEFT JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id AND i.presence = FALSE WHERE i.id IS NULL ORDER BY CASE p.jour_semaine WHEN 'Lundi' THEN 1 WHEN 'Mardi' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mercredi' THEN 3 WHEN 'Jeudi' THEN 4 WHEN 'Vendredi' THEN 5 WHEN 'Samedi' THEN 6 WHEN 'Dimanche' THEN 7 END, p.heure_debut, c.nom, p.id;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, ab.date_fin FROM adherents a JOIN abonnements ab ON ab.adherent_id = a.id WHERE ab.date_fin IS NOT NULL AND ab.date_fin < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY ab.date_fin, a.nom, a.prenom, ab.id;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscriptions FROM coachs c JOIN cours co ON co.coach_id = c.id JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = co.id JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY nb_inscriptions DESC, c.nom, c.prenom, c.id LIMIT 3;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT i.planning_id) AS nb_creneaux, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT i.planning_id) DESC) AS rang FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom ORDER BY rang, a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_debut) AS mois, SUM(prix) AS montant FROM abonnements GROUP BY mois) SELECT mois, montant, LAG(montant) OVER (ORDER BY mois) AS montant_precedent, montant - LAG(montant) OVER (ORDER BY mois) AS difference FROM stats ORDER BY mois;

WITH stats AS (SELECT a.id, a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT i.planning_id) AS nb_creneaux FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom) SELECT prenom, nom, nb_creneaux, ROUND(nb_creneaux - (SELECT AVG(nb_creneaux) FROM stats), 2) AS ecart_moyenne FROM stats WHERE nb_creneaux > (SELECT AVG(nb_creneaux) FROM stats) ORDER BY nb_creneaux DESC, nom, prenom, id;

SELECT c.nom, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.presence THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id), 1) AS taux_presence_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.presence THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rang FROM cours c JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY rang, c.nom, c.id;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, co.prenom || ' ' || co.nom AS coach FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id JOIN planning p ON p.id = i.planning_id JOIN cours c ON c.id = p.cours_id JOIN coachs co ON co.id = c.coach_id WHERE i.presence = TRUE GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom, co.id, co.prenom, co.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) FROM cours c2 WHERE c2.coach_id = co.id) ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, co.nom, co.prenom;

WITH stats AS (SELECT co.id AS coach_id, co.prenom || ' ' || co.nom AS coach, c.id AS cours_id, c.nom AS cours, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits FROM coachs co JOIN cours c ON c.coach_id = co.id LEFT JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = c.id LEFT JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY co.id, co.prenom, co.nom, c.id, c.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT coach_id, AVG(nb_inscrits) AS moyenne FROM stats GROUP BY coach_id) SELECT s.coach, s.cours, s.nb_inscrits, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_coach FROM stats s JOIN moyennes m ON m.coach_id = s.coach_id WHERE s.nb_inscrits > m.moyenne ORDER BY s.coach, s.nb_inscrits DESC, s.cours, s.cours_id;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rang FROM coachs c LEFT JOIN cours co ON co.coach_id = c.id LEFT JOIN planning p ON p.cours_id = co.id LEFT JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.planning_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY rang, c.nom, c.prenom, c.id;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT p.salle_id) AS nb_salles FROM adherents a JOIN inscriptions_cours i ON i.adherent_id = a.id JOIN planning p ON p.id = i.planning_id WHERE i.presence = TRUE GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.salle_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_salles DESC, a.nom, a.prenom, a.id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT a.id, ab.type, a.prenom, a.nom, SUM(ab.prix) AS total FROM adherents a JOIN abonnements ab ON ab.adherent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, ab.type, a.prenom, a.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT type, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY type) SELECT t.type, t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_type FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.type = t.type WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.type, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.prenom, t.id;
SELECT p.nom, p.longueur_m, r.nom AS remontee FROM pistes p JOIN remontees r ON r.id = p.remontee_id WHERE p.couleur = 'Noire' AND p.etat = 'Ouverte' ORDER BY p.longueur_m DESC, p.nom;
SELECT nom, type, altitude_arrivee - altitude_depart AS denivele FROM remontees ORDER BY denivele DESC, nom LIMIT 3;
SELECT id, tarif, prix, date_debut FROM forfaits WHERE client_id IS NULL ORDER BY date_debut, id;
SELECT DISTINCT r.nom, r.type FROM passages p JOIN remontees r ON r.id = p.remontee_id WHERE p.date_passage = '2025-02-18' ORDER BY r.nom;
SELECT date_jour, etat_domaine, motif_fermeture, vent_kmh FROM meteo WHERE etat_domaine <> 'Ouvert' ORDER BY date_jour;
SELECT prenom || ' ' || UPPER(nom) AS badge, specialite FROM moniteurs ORDER BY nom;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_passages, COUNT(DISTINCT forfait_id) AS nb_forfaits FROM passages WHERE date_passage = '2025-02-15';
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, c.email, f.prix FROM forfaits f JOIN clients c ON c.id = f.client_id WHERE f.type = 'Saison' ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT nom, ROUND(denivele_m * 100.0 / longueur_m, 1) AS pente_pct FROM pistes WHERE couleur = 'Rouge' ORDER BY pente_pct DESC, nom;

SELECT c.date_cours, c.heure_debut, c.discipline, m.prenom, m.nom FROM cours c JOIN moniteurs m ON m.id = c.moniteur_id WHERE c.statut = 'Maintenu' AND strftime('%w', c.date_cours) IN ('0', '6') ORDER BY c.date_cours, c.heure_debut;
SELECT r.nom, r.type, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_passages FROM remontees r LEFT JOIN passages p ON p.remontee_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.nom, r.type ORDER BY nb_passages DESC, r.nom;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_achat) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nb_forfaits, SUM(prix) AS recette, ROUND(AVG(prix), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM forfaits GROUP BY mois HAVING SUM(prix) > 1500 ORDER BY mois;

SELECT c.date_cours, c.heure_debut, c.discipline, c.niveau, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits FROM cours c JOIN inscriptions i ON i.cours_id = c.id WHERE c.statut = 'Maintenu' GROUP BY c.id, c.date_cours, c.heure_debut, c.discipline, c.niveau, c.places_max HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= c.places_max ORDER BY c.date_cours, c.heure_debut;

SELECT couleur, COUNT(*) AS nb_pistes, SUM(CASE WHEN etat = 'Ouverte' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_ouvertes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN etat = 'Ouverte' THEN longueur_m ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 1) AS km_ouverts FROM pistes GROUP BY couleur ORDER BY nb_ouvertes DESC, couleur;
SELECT f.id, f.type, f.date_debut, c.prenom, c.nom FROM forfaits f LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = f.client_id LEFT JOIN passages p ON p.forfait_id = f.id WHERE p.id IS NULL ORDER BY f.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN heure_passage < '09:00' THEN 'Ouverture' WHEN heure_passage < '12:00' THEN 'Matinée' WHEN heure_passage < '14:00' THEN 'Midi' ELSE 'Après-midi' END AS creneau, COUNT(*) AS nb_passages FROM passages GROUP BY creneau ORDER BY nb_passages DESC;
SELECT date_jour, hauteur_neige_cm FROM meteo WHERE hauteur_neige_cm > (SELECT AVG(hauteur_neige_cm) FROM meteo) ORDER BY date_jour;
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS nb_forfaits, ROUND(AVG(julianday(date_debut) - julianday(date_achat)), 1) AS delai_moyen FROM forfaits GROUP BY type ORDER BY delai_moyen DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT cl.prenom, cl.nom, cl.date_naissance FROM moniteurs m JOIN cours c ON c.moniteur_id = m.id JOIN inscriptions i ON i.cours_id = c.id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = i.client_id WHERE m.prenom = 'Océane' AND m.nom = 'Perrin' AND c.statut = 'Maintenu' ORDER BY cl.nom, cl.prenom;
SELECT p.secteur, p.nom, p.couleur, COALESCE(r.nom, 'Liaison') AS remontee FROM pistes p LEFT JOIN remontees r ON r.id = p.remontee_id WHERE p.etat = 'Ouverte' ORDER BY p.secteur, p.nom;

SELECT m.prenom, m.nom, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscriptions, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rang FROM moniteurs m LEFT JOIN cours c ON c.moniteur_id = m.id AND c.statut = 'Maintenu' LEFT JOIN inscriptions i ON i.cours_id = c.id GROUP BY m.id, m.prenom, m.nom ORDER BY rang, m.nom;

WITH variations AS (SELECT date_jour, hauteur_neige_cm, LAG(hauteur_neige_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date_jour) AS hauteur_veille FROM meteo) SELECT date_jour, hauteur_neige_cm, hauteur_veille, hauteur_neige_cm - hauteur_veille AS ecart FROM variations WHERE hauteur_neige_cm < hauteur_veille ORDER BY date_jour;

SELECT m.date_jour, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_passages, SUM(COUNT(p.id)) OVER (ORDER BY m.date_jour) AS cumul FROM meteo m LEFT JOIN passages p ON p.date_passage = m.date_jour GROUP BY m.date_jour ORDER BY m.date_jour;

SELECT f.id, f.type, f.prix, COUNT(m.id) AS jours_fermes, ROUND(f.prix * COUNT(m.id) / (julianday(f.date_fin) - julianday(f.date_debut) + 1), 2) AS remboursement FROM forfaits f JOIN meteo m ON m.date_jour BETWEEN f.date_debut AND f.date_fin AND m.etat_domaine = 'Fermé' WHERE f.type IN ('Journée', 'Semaine') GROUP BY f.id, f.type, f.prix, f.date_debut, f.date_fin ORDER BY f.id;

WITH par_cours AS (SELECT c.id, c.discipline, c.niveau, c.places_max, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_inscrits FROM cours c LEFT JOIN inscriptions i ON i.cours_id = c.id WHERE c.statut = 'Maintenu' GROUP BY c.id, c.discipline, c.niveau, c.places_max) SELECT discipline, niveau, SUM(nb_inscrits) AS inscrits, SUM(places_max) AS places, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(nb_inscrits) / SUM(places_max), 1) AS taux FROM par_cours GROUP BY discipline, niveau ORDER BY taux DESC;

WITH pentes AS (SELECT couleur, nom, denivele_m * 100.0 / longueur_m AS pente FROM pistes), moyennes AS (SELECT couleur, AVG(pente) AS moyenne FROM pentes GROUP BY couleur) SELECT p.couleur, p.nom, ROUND(p.pente, 1) AS pente_pct, ROUND(m.moyenne, 1) AS moyenne_couleur FROM pentes p JOIN moyennes m ON m.couleur = p.couleur WHERE p.pente > m.moyenne ORDER BY p.couleur, p.pente DESC, p.nom;

SELECT cl.prenom, cl.nom FROM clients cl WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remontees r WHERE r.secteur = 'Crêtes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passages p JOIN forfaits f ON f.id = p.forfait_id WHERE f.client_id = cl.id AND p.remontee_id = r.id)) ORDER BY cl.nom, cl.prenom;

WITH classes AS (SELECT p.date_passage, p.heure_passage, p.forfait_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.date_passage ORDER BY p.heure_passage, p.id) AS rang FROM passages p) SELECT c.date_passage, c.heure_passage, c.forfait_id, cl.prenom, cl.nom FROM classes c JOIN forfaits f ON f.id = c.forfait_id LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = f.client_id WHERE c.rang = 1 ORDER BY c.date_passage;

SELECT DISTINCT a.prenom, a.nom FROM clients l JOIN inscriptions il ON il.client_id = l.id JOIN cours c ON c.id = il.cours_id JOIN inscriptions ia ON ia.cours_id = il.cours_id JOIN clients a ON a.id = ia.client_id WHERE l.prenom = 'Lina' AND l.nom = 'Vidal' AND c.statut = 'Maintenu' AND a.id <> l.id ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom;

WITH ages AS (SELECT f.id, c.prenom, c.nom, f.tarif, CAST(strftime('%Y', f.date_debut) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.date_naissance) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', f.date_debut) < strftime('%m-%d', c.date_naissance)) AS age FROM forfaits f JOIN clients c ON c.id = f.client_id) SELECT id, prenom, nom, age, tarif, CASE WHEN age < 12 THEN 'Enfant' WHEN age < 65 THEN 'Adulte' ELSE 'Senior' END AS tarif_attendu FROM ages WHERE tarif <> CASE WHEN age < 12 THEN 'Enfant' WHEN age < 65 THEN 'Adulte' ELSE 'Senior' END ORDER BY id;
SELECT nom, type FROM emplacements WHERE borne_electrique = 0 ORDER BY nom;
SELECT p.nom, c.nom AS vehicule, p.prix FROM plats p JOIN camions c ON c.id = p.camion_id WHERE p.vegetarien = 1 AND p.categorie = 'Plat' ORDER BY p.prix, p.nom;
SELECT DISTINCT date_sortie FROM sorties WHERE meteo = 'Pluie' ORDER BY date_sortie;
SELECT v.id, s.date_sortie, v.heure_commande FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id WHERE v.heure_remise IS NULL ORDER BY v.id;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_ventes, SUM(montant) AS total FROM ventes WHERE mode_paiement = 'Titre-restaurant';
SELECT nom, LENGTH(nom) AS nb_caracteres FROM plats WHERE LENGTH(nom) > 20 ORDER BY nb_caracteres DESC;
SELECT prenom, nom, tampons FROM clients WHERE tampons >= 8 ORDER BY tampons DESC, nom, prenom;
SELECT v.id, s.date_sortie, v.montant FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id ORDER BY v.montant DESC, v.id LIMIT 5;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_carte FROM clients WHERE strftime('%Y', date_carte) = '2024' ORDER BY date_carte;
SELECT p.nom, s.date_sortie, r.heure_rupture FROM ruptures r JOIN plats p ON p.id = r.plat_id JOIN sorties s ON s.id = r.sortie_id WHERE r.heure_rupture < '12:00' ORDER BY r.heure_rupture;
SELECT e.nom, COUNT(s.id) AS nb_sorties FROM emplacements e LEFT JOIN sorties s ON s.emplacement_id = e.id AND s.statut = 'Effectuée' GROUP BY e.id, e.nom ORDER BY nb_sorties DESC, e.nom;

SELECT c.nom, ROUND(AVG((strftime('%s', v.heure_remise) - strftime('%s', v.heure_commande)) / 60.0), 1) AS attente_moyenne FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id JOIN camions c ON c.id = s.camion_id WHERE v.heure_remise IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY attente_moyenne DESC;

SELECT s.meteo, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS nb_sorties, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_ventes, SUM(v.montant) AS ca FROM sorties s JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id WHERE s.statut = 'Effectuée' GROUP BY s.meteo ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN heure_commande < '11:00' THEN 'Matin' WHEN heure_commande < '15:00' THEN 'Midi' WHEN heure_commande < '18:00' THEN 'Après-midi' ELSE 'Soir' END AS moment, COUNT(*) AS nb_ventes, SUM(montant) AS ca FROM ventes GROUP BY moment;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_ventes FROM clients c JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom HAVING COUNT(v.id) >= 5 ORDER BY nb_ventes DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;
SELECT p.nom, c.nom AS vehicule FROM plats p JOIN camions c ON c.id = p.camion_id LEFT JOIN lignes_vente l ON l.plat_id = p.id WHERE l.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.nom, p.nom;

SELECT c.nom AS vehicule, p.nom AS plat, SUM(l.quantite) AS portions FROM lignes_vente l JOIN plats p ON p.id = l.plat_id JOIN camions c ON c.id = p.camion_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom, p.id, p.nom ORDER BY c.nom, portions DESC, p.nom;
SELECT nom, prix FROM plats WHERE prix > (SELECT AVG(prix) FROM plats) ORDER BY prix DESC, nom;
SELECT c.prenom, c.nom, COALESCE(SUM(v.montant), 0) AS total FROM clients c LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.prenom, c.nom ORDER BY total DESC, c.nom, c.prenom;

SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.date_sortie) WHEN '0' THEN 'dimanche' WHEN '1' THEN 'lundi' WHEN '2' THEN 'mardi' WHEN '3' THEN 'mercredi' WHEN '4' THEN 'jeudi' WHEN '5' THEN 'vendredi' ELSE 'samedi' END AS jour, SUM(v.montant) AS ca FROM sorties s JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id GROUP BY jour ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT e.nom, COALESCE(SUM(v.montant), 0) AS ca, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(v.montant), 0) DESC) AS rang FROM emplacements e LEFT JOIN sorties s ON s.emplacement_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom ORDER BY rang, e.nom;

WITH matins AS (SELECT s.date_sortie, SUM(l.quantite) AS portions FROM sorties s JOIN camions c ON c.id = s.camion_id JOIN emplacements e ON e.id = s.emplacement_id JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id JOIN lignes_vente l ON l.vente_id = v.id WHERE c.nom = 'Le Carbu' AND e.nom = 'Parvis de la gare' AND s.statut = 'Effectuée' GROUP BY s.id, s.date_sortie) SELECT date_sortie, portions, LAG(portions) OVER (ORDER BY date_sortie) AS portions_precedentes, portions - LAG(portions) OVER (ORDER BY date_sortie) AS ecart FROM matins ORDER BY date_sortie;

WITH jours AS (SELECT c.id AS camion_id, c.nom, s.date_sortie, SUM(v.montant) AS ca FROM camions c JOIN sorties s ON s.camion_id = c.id JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom, s.date_sortie) SELECT nom, date_sortie, ca, SUM(ca) OVER (PARTITION BY camion_id ORDER BY date_sortie) AS cumul FROM jours ORDER BY nom, date_sortie;

WITH attentes AS (SELECT v.id, s.camion_id, (strftime('%s', v.heure_remise) - strftime('%s', v.heure_commande)) / 60 AS attente FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id WHERE v.heure_remise IS NOT NULL), moyennes AS (SELECT camion_id, AVG(attente) AS moyenne FROM attentes GROUP BY camion_id) SELECT c.nom, a.id, a.attente, ROUND(m.moyenne, 1) AS moyenne_vehicule FROM attentes a JOIN moyennes m ON m.camion_id = a.camion_id JOIN camions c ON c.id = a.camion_id WHERE a.attente > m.moyenne + 5 ORDER BY c.nom, a.attente DESC, a.id;

SELECT a.date_sortie, e.nom AS emplacement, ca.nom AS vehicule_1, cb.nom AS vehicule_2 FROM sorties a JOIN sorties b ON b.emplacement_id = a.emplacement_id AND b.date_sortie = a.date_sortie AND a.heure_debut < b.heure_fin AND b.heure_debut < a.heure_fin JOIN camions ca ON ca.id = a.camion_id JOIN camions cb ON cb.id = b.camion_id JOIN emplacements e ON e.id = a.emplacement_id WHERE a.statut = 'Effectuée' AND b.statut = 'Effectuée' AND ca.nom < cb.nom ORDER BY a.date_sortie, e.nom, ca.nom, cb.nom;

SELECT c.prenom, c.nom FROM clients c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM camions k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id WHERE v.client_id = c.id AND s.camion_id = k.id)) ORDER BY c.nom, c.prenom;

WITH parts AS (SELECT c.nom AS vehicule, e.type, SUM(CASE WHEN v.mode_paiement = 'Espèces' THEN v.montant ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(v.montant) AS part FROM ventes v JOIN sorties s ON s.id = v.sortie_id JOIN camions c ON c.id = s.camion_id JOIN emplacements e ON e.id = s.emplacement_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom, e.type), flotte AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mode_paiement = 'Espèces' THEN montant ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(montant) AS part FROM ventes) SELECT p.vehicule, p.type, ROUND(p.part, 1) AS part_especes, ROUND(f.part, 1) AS part_flotte FROM parts p CROSS JOIN flotte f WHERE p.part > f.part ORDER BY p.part DESC;

WITH portions_plats AS (SELECT p.camion_id, p.nom, SUM(l.quantite) AS portions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.camion_id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantite) DESC, p.nom) AS rn FROM plats p JOIN lignes_vente l ON l.plat_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.camion_id, p.nom) SELECT c.nom, pp.nom, pp.portions FROM portions_plats pp JOIN camions c ON c.id = pp.camion_id WHERE pp.rn = 1 ORDER BY c.nom;

SELECT s.date_sortie, p.nom, r.heure_rupture, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_ventes_apres FROM ruptures r JOIN sorties s ON s.id = r.sortie_id JOIN plats p ON p.id = r.plat_id LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = r.sortie_id AND v.heure_commande > r.heure_rupture GROUP BY r.id, s.date_sortie, p.nom, r.heure_rupture ORDER BY nb_ventes_apres DESC, s.date_sortie, r.heure_rupture;

WITH ca AS (SELECT s.camion_id, SUM(v.montant) AS ca FROM sorties s JOIN ventes v ON v.sortie_id = s.id GROUP BY s.camion_id), redevances AS (SELECT s.camion_id, SUM(e.redevance) AS redevances FROM sorties s JOIN emplacements e ON e.id = s.emplacement_id WHERE s.statut = 'Effectuée' GROUP BY s.camion_id) SELECT c.nom, ca.ca, r.redevances, ca.ca - r.redevances AS reste FROM camions c JOIN ca ON ca.camion_id = c.id JOIN redevances r ON r.camion_id = c.id ORDER BY reste DESC;
SELECT nom, volume_litres, temp_min_c, temp_max_c FROM bassins WHERE type_eau = 'Eau douce' ORDER BY volume_litres DESC, nom;
SELECT id, type, date_installation, statut FROM equipements WHERE bassin_id IS NULL ORDER BY date_installation, id;
SELECT nom, ROUND(volume_litres / 1000.0, 1) AS volume_m3 FROM bassins WHERE volume_litres < 10000 ORDER BY volume_litres, nom;
SELECT DISTINCT espece FROM pensionnaires WHERE provenance = 'Collecte' ORDER BY espece;
SELECT SUM(effectif) AS nb_requins FROM pensionnaires WHERE categorie = 'Requin';

SELECT r.etablissement, a.nom, r.date_animation, r.heure_debut, r.nb_eleves FROM reservations r JOIN animations a ON a.id = r.animation_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', r.date_animation) = '2025-05' AND r.statut <> 'Annulée' ORDER BY r.date_animation, r.heure_debut, r.nb_eleves DESC;
SELECT nom, LENGTH(nom) AS nb_caracteres FROM bassins WHERE LENGTH(nom) > 20 ORDER BY nb_caracteres DESC, nom;
SELECT p.espece, p.effectif, b.nom AS bassin FROM pensionnaires p JOIN bassins b ON b.id = p.bassin_id ORDER BY p.effectif DESC, p.espece LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.nom, r.date_releve, r.heure_releve, r.nitrates_mg_l FROM releves r JOIN bassins b ON b.id = r.bassin_id WHERE r.nitrates_mg_l > 25 ORDER BY r.nitrates_mg_l DESC, r.date_releve, r.heure_releve;
SELECT i.date_debut, e.type, i.cout, i.description FROM interventions i JOIN equipements e ON e.id = i.equipement_id WHERE i.description LIKE '%fuite%' ORDER BY i.date_debut;
