SELECT b.nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_groupes, COALESCE(SUM(p.effectif), 0) AS nb_animaux FROM bassins b LEFT JOIN pensionnaires p ON p.bassin_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.nom ORDER BY nb_animaux DESC, b.nom;

SELECT b.nom, r.date_releve, r.heure_releve, r.temperature_c, CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.temp_min_c THEN 'Trop froid' ELSE 'Trop chaud' END AS sens FROM releves r JOIN bassins b ON b.id = r.bassin_id WHERE r.temperature_c < b.temp_min_c OR r.temperature_c > b.temp_max_c ORDER BY r.date_releve, r.heure_releve, b.nom;
SELECT espece, COUNT(DISTINCT bassin_id) AS nb_bassins, SUM(effectif) AS nb_animaux FROM pensionnaires GROUP BY espece HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bassin_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_bassins DESC, espece;

SELECT b.nom, MIN(r.temperature_c) AS temp_basse, MAX(r.temperature_c) AS temp_haute, ROUND(MAX(r.temperature_c) - MIN(r.temperature_c), 1) AS amplitude FROM bassins b JOIN releves r ON r.bassin_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.nom ORDER BY amplitude DESC, b.nom;

SELECT e.type, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_pannes, ROUND(AVG(julianday(i.date_fin) - julianday(i.date_debut)), 1) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM interventions i JOIN equipements e ON e.id = i.equipement_id WHERE i.type_intervention = 'Panne' AND i.date_fin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type ORDER BY duree_moyenne_jours DESC, nb_pannes DESC;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.date_animation) AS mois, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, SUM(r.nb_eleves) AS nb_eleves, SUM(r.nb_eleves * a.prix_eleve) AS recette FROM reservations r JOIN animations a ON a.id = r.animation_id WHERE r.statut = 'Confirmée' GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois;

SELECT b.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_releves, COUNT(r.id) - COUNT(r.nitrates_mg_l) AS nb_sans_nitrates FROM bassins b JOIN releves r ON r.bassin_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.nom HAVING COUNT(r.id) - COUNT(r.nitrates_mg_l) > 0 ORDER BY nb_sans_nitrates DESC, b.nom;

SELECT p.espece, b.nom, p.effectif FROM pensionnaires p JOIN bassins b ON b.id = p.bassin_id WHERE p.bassin_id IN (SELECT bassin_id FROM equipements WHERE statut = 'En panne') ORDER BY b.nom, p.espece;

SELECT COALESCE(prestataire, 'Équipe interne') AS prestataire, COUNT(*) AS nb_interventions, SUM(cout) AS cout_total FROM interventions GROUP BY COALESCE(prestataire, 'Équipe interne') ORDER BY cout_total DESC;
SELECT a.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_confirmees FROM animations a LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.animation_id = a.id AND r.statut = 'Confirmée' GROUP BY a.id, a.nom ORDER BY nb_confirmees DESC, a.nom;

WITH suivi AS (SELECT b.nom, b.zone, r.date_releve, r.heure_releve, r.temperature_c, LAG(r.temperature_c) OVER (PARTITION BY r.bassin_id ORDER BY r.date_releve, r.heure_releve) AS temperature_precedente FROM releves r JOIN bassins b ON b.id = r.bassin_id) SELECT nom, date_releve, heure_releve, temperature_c, temperature_precedente, ROUND(temperature_c - temperature_precedente, 1) AS ecart FROM suivi WHERE zone = 'Galerie atlantique' AND date_releve BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-02' ORDER BY nom, date_releve, heure_releve;

WITH suivis AS (SELECT b.nom, r.date_releve, LAG(r.date_releve) OVER (PARTITION BY r.bassin_id ORDER BY r.date_releve, r.heure_releve) AS date_precedente FROM releves r JOIN bassins b ON b.id = r.bassin_id) SELECT nom, date_precedente, date_releve, julianday(date_releve) - julianday(date_precedente) AS nb_jours FROM suivis WHERE julianday(date_releve) - julianday(date_precedente) > 3 ORDER BY nb_jours DESC, nom;

WITH classes AS (SELECT b.nom, r.date_releve, r.heure_releve, r.temperature_c, r.ph, r.nitrates_mg_l, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.bassin_id ORDER BY r.date_releve DESC, r.heure_releve DESC) AS rang FROM releves r JOIN bassins b ON b.id = r.bassin_id) SELECT nom, date_releve, heure_releve, temperature_c, ph, nitrates_mg_l FROM classes WHERE rang = 1 ORDER BY nom;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_releves, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC) AS rang FROM aquariologistes a LEFT JOIN releves r ON r.aquariologiste_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom ORDER BY rang, a.nom;

WITH jours AS (SELECT date_animation, SUM(nb_eleves) AS nb_eleves FROM reservations WHERE statut = 'Confirmée' AND date_animation BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY date_animation) SELECT date_animation, nb_eleves, SUM(nb_eleves) OVER (ORDER BY date_animation) AS cumul FROM jours ORDER BY date_animation;

SELECT e.id, e.type, b.nom AS bassin, e.date_installation FROM equipements e LEFT JOIN bassins b ON b.id = e.bassin_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interventions i WHERE i.equipement_id = e.id AND i.type_intervention = 'Panne') ORDER BY e.date_installation, e.id;

SELECT a.nom, r1.date_animation, r1.heure_debut, r1.etablissement, r2.etablissement FROM reservations r1 JOIN reservations r2 ON r2.animation_id = r1.animation_id AND r2.date_animation = r1.date_animation AND r2.heure_debut = r1.heure_debut AND r2.id > r1.id JOIN animations a ON a.id = r1.animation_id WHERE r1.statut <> 'Annulée' AND r2.statut <> 'Annulée' ORDER BY r1.date_animation, r1.heure_debut;

SELECT b.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_releves, SUM(CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.temp_min_c OR r.temperature_c > b.temp_max_c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_hors_limites, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.temp_min_c OR r.temperature_c > b.temp_max_c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.id), 1) AS part_pct FROM bassins b JOIN releves r ON r.bassin_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.nom ORDER BY part_pct DESC, b.nom;

WITH couts AS (SELECT e.type, i.id, i.date_debut, i.cout FROM interventions i JOIN equipements e ON e.id = i.equipement_id), moyennes AS (SELECT type, AVG(cout) AS moyenne FROM couts GROUP BY type) SELECT c.type, c.id, c.date_debut, c.cout, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_type FROM couts c JOIN moyennes m ON m.type = c.type WHERE c.cout > m.moyenne ORDER BY c.cout DESC;

SELECT b.nom, COALESCE(SUM(i.cout), 0) AS cout_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(i.cout), 0) DESC) AS rang FROM bassins b LEFT JOIN equipements e ON e.bassin_id = b.id LEFT JOIN interventions i ON i.equipement_id = e.id GROUP BY b.id, b.nom ORDER BY rang, b.nom;
SELECT p.id, v.numero, p.type_panne, p.date_signalement FROM pannes p JOIN velos v ON v.id = p.velo_id WHERE p.date_reparation IS NULL ORDER BY p.date_signalement, p.id;
SELECT t.id, a.prenom, a.nom, t.date_trajet, t.duree_min FROM trajets t JOIN abonnes a ON a.id = t.abonne_id WHERE t.duree_min > 45 ORDER BY t.duree_min DESC, t.id;

SELECT t.id, s.nom, t.date_trajet, t.heure_depart, t.duree_min FROM trajets t JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.station_depart_id WHERE t.station_arrivee_id = t.station_depart_id ORDER BY t.date_trajet, t.heure_depart, t.id;
SELECT nom, quartier, nb_bornes FROM stations WHERE nb_bornes >= 10 ORDER BY nb_bornes DESC, nom;
SELECT DISTINCT type_panne FROM pannes WHERE date_signalement BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31' ORDER BY type_panne;
SELECT nom, LENGTH(nom) AS longueur FROM stations WHERE LENGTH(nom) > 16 ORDER BY longueur DESC, nom;
SELECT numero, date_mise_en_service, statut FROM velos WHERE type = 'Électrique' AND date_mise_en_service IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date_mise_en_service, numero LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_trajets FROM trajets WHERE date_trajet BETWEEN '2025-06-02' AND '2025-06-06' AND heure_depart >= '07:00' AND heure_depart < '09:00';
SELECT SUM(nb_velos) AS total_velos FROM regulations WHERE heure_operation < '12:00';
SELECT UPPER(nom) AS nom_majuscules, prenom, date_inscription FROM abonnes WHERE date_inscription BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31' ORDER BY date_inscription, nom;
SELECT s.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT t.abonne_id) AS nb_abonnes FROM stations s LEFT JOIN trajets t ON t.station_depart_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY nb_abonnes DESC, s.nom;

SELECT s.quartier, v.type, COUNT(t.id) AS nb_trajets, ROUND(AVG(t.duree_min), 1) AS duree_moyenne FROM trajets t JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.station_depart_id JOIN velos v ON v.id = t.velo_id GROUP BY s.quartier, v.type ORDER BY s.quartier, v.type;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, COUNT(t.id) AS nb_trajets, SUM(t.duree_min) AS duree_totale FROM abonnes a JOIN trajets t ON t.abonne_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom HAVING COUNT(t.id) >= 6 ORDER BY nb_trajets DESC, a.nom, a.prenom;

SELECT type_panne, COUNT(*) AS nb_reparees, ROUND(AVG(julianday(date_reparation) - julianday(date_signalement)), 1) AS delai_moyen_jours, ROUND(AVG(cout_reparation), 2) AS cout_moyen FROM pannes WHERE date_reparation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type_panne ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC, type_panne;
SELECT CASE WHEN duree_min < 15 THEN 'Moins de 15 min' WHEN duree_min <= 45 THEN 'De 15 à 45 min' ELSE 'Plus de 45 min' END AS tranche, COUNT(*) AS nb_trajets FROM trajets GROUP BY tranche;

SELECT t.id, a.prenom, a.nom, f.nom AS formule, t.duree_min, t.duree_min - f.minutes_incluses AS depassement FROM trajets t JOIN abonnes a ON a.id = t.abonne_id JOIN formules f ON f.id = a.formule_id WHERE t.duree_min > f.minutes_incluses ORDER BY depassement DESC, t.id;

SELECT strftime('%H', heure_depart) AS heure, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', date_trajet) IN ('0', '6') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS en_semaine, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', date_trajet) IN ('0', '6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_end FROM trajets GROUP BY heure ORDER BY heure;
SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, t.date_trajet, t.duree_min FROM trajets t JOIN abonnes a ON a.id = t.abonne_id WHERE t.duree_min = (SELECT MAX(duree_min) FROM trajets) ORDER BY t.date_trajet, t.id;

SELECT v.numero, COALESCE(SUM(t.duree_min), 0) AS minutes_roulees FROM velos v LEFT JOIN trajets t ON t.velo_id = v.id WHERE v.type = 'Mécanique' AND v.statut = 'En service' GROUP BY v.id, v.numero ORDER BY minutes_roulees DESC, v.numero;

SELECT s.nom, s.quartier, COUNT(*) AS nb_releves_vides FROM releves r JOIN stations s ON s.id = r.station_id WHERE r.nb_velos = 0 AND r.heure_releve IN ('08:00', '18:00') GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, s.quartier ORDER BY nb_releves_vides DESC, s.nom;

WITH departs AS (SELECT station_depart_id AS station_id, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM trajets GROUP BY station_depart_id), arrivees AS (SELECT station_arrivee_id AS station_id, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM trajets GROUP BY station_arrivee_id) SELECT s.nom, COALESCE(d.nb, 0) AS nb_departs, COALESCE(a.nb, 0) AS nb_arrivees, COALESCE(a.nb, 0) - COALESCE(d.nb, 0) AS solde FROM stations s LEFT JOIN departs d ON d.station_id = s.id LEFT JOIN arrivees a ON a.station_id = s.id ORDER BY solde, s.nom;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, f.nom AS formule, COUNT(t.id) AS nb_trajets FROM abonnes a JOIN formules f ON f.id = a.formule_id JOIN trajets t ON t.abonne_id = a.id WHERE f.nom IN ('Annuelle', 'Mensuelle') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trajets t2 JOIN velos v ON v.id = t2.velo_id WHERE t2.abonne_id = a.id AND v.type = 'Électrique') GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom, f.nom ORDER BY nb_trajets DESC, a.nom, a.prenom;

SELECT s.nom, COALESCE(SUM(r.nb_velos), 0) AS velos_deposes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.nb_velos), 0) DESC) AS rang FROM stations s LEFT JOIN regulations r ON r.station_destination_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY rang, s.nom;

SELECT v.type, v.numero, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_pannes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY v.type ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC) AS rang FROM velos v JOIN pannes p ON p.velo_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.type, v.numero ORDER BY v.type, rang, v.numero;

WITH suite AS (SELECT t.velo_id, t.date_trajet, t.heure_depart, t.station_depart_id, LAG(t.station_arrivee_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.velo_id ORDER BY t.date_trajet, t.heure_depart, t.id) AS arrivee_precedente FROM trajets t) SELECT v.numero, s.date_trajet, s.heure_depart, sp.nom AS station_precedente, sd.nom AS station_depart FROM suite s JOIN velos v ON v.id = s.velo_id JOIN stations sp ON sp.id = s.arrivee_precedente JOIN stations sd ON sd.id = s.station_depart_id WHERE s.station_depart_id <> s.arrivee_precedente ORDER BY v.numero, s.date_trajet, s.heure_depart;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_inscription) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nb_inscrits, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_inscription)) AS cumul FROM abonnes GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois;

SELECT numero, date_trajet, heure_arrivee, station_arrivee FROM (SELECT v.numero, t.date_trajet, t.heure_arrivee, s.nom AS station_arrivee, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.id ORDER BY t.date_trajet DESC, t.heure_depart DESC) AS rn FROM velos v JOIN trajets t ON t.velo_id = v.id JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.station_arrivee_id WHERE v.type = 'Électrique') AS derniers WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY numero;

SELECT a.prenom, a.nom, sa.nom AS station_aller, sb.nom AS station_retour, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.date_trajet) AS nb_jours FROM trajets t1 JOIN trajets t2 ON t2.abonne_id = t1.abonne_id AND t2.date_trajet = t1.date_trajet AND t2.station_depart_id = t1.station_arrivee_id AND t2.station_arrivee_id = t1.station_depart_id AND t2.heure_depart > t1.heure_depart JOIN abonnes a ON a.id = t1.abonne_id JOIN stations sa ON sa.id = t1.station_depart_id JOIN stations sb ON sb.id = t1.station_arrivee_id WHERE t1.station_depart_id <> t1.station_arrivee_id GROUP BY a.id, a.prenom, a.nom, sa.nom, sb.nom ORDER BY a.nom, a.prenom, station_aller;

SELECT f.nom, COUNT(t.id) AS nb_trajets, SUM(CASE WHEN v.type = 'Électrique' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nb_electriques, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN v.type = 'Électrique' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id), 1) AS part_electrique FROM formules f JOIN abonnes a ON a.formule_id = f.id JOIN trajets t ON t.abonne_id = a.id JOIN velos v ON v.id = t.velo_id GROUP BY f.id, f.nom ORDER BY part_electrique DESC, f.nom;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT a.id, f.nom AS formule, a.prenom, a.nom, SUM(t.duree_min) AS total FROM abonnes a JOIN formules f ON f.id = a.formule_id JOIN trajets t ON t.abonne_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, f.nom, a.prenom, a.nom), moyennes AS (SELECT formule, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY formule) SELECT t.formule, t.prenom, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(m.moyenne) AS moyenne_formule FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.formule = t.formule WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.formule, t.total DESC, t.nom;
SELECT r.nom, ru.nom AS rucher, r.race, r.date_installation FROM ruches r JOIN ruchers ru ON ru.id = r.rucher_id WHERE r.etat = 'Morte' ORDER BY r.date_installation, r.nom, r.id;
SELECT v.date_visite, r.nom, v.remarque FROM visites v JOIN ruches r ON r.id = v.ruche_id WHERE v.varroa IS NULL ORDER BY v.date_visite, r.nom, r.id;
SELECT nom, commune, altitude_m FROM ruchers WHERE altitude_m > 600 ORDER BY altitude_m DESC, nom, id;
SELECT DISTINCT race FROM ruches ORDER BY race;
SELECT r.nom, rc.date_recolte, rc.type_miel, rc.poids_kg FROM recoltes rc JOIN ruches r ON r.id = rc.ruche_id ORDER BY rc.poids_kg DESC, rc.date_recolte, rc.id LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_recoltes, SUM(poids_kg) AS poids_total_kg FROM recoltes WHERE type_miel = 'Lavande' AND date_recolte BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';
SELECT r.nom, v.date_visite, v.remarque FROM visites v JOIN ruches r ON r.id = v.ruche_id WHERE v.remarque LIKE '%essaim%' ORDER BY v.date_visite, r.nom, r.id;
SELECT numero_lot, contenance_g, prix_pot, ROUND(prix_pot * 1000 / contenance_g, 2) AS prix_kg FROM lots WHERE annee_recolte = 2025 ORDER BY prix_kg DESC, numero_lot;
SELECT nom, ville, jour FROM points_vente WHERE jour IN ('Samedi', 'Dimanche') ORDER BY nom, id;
SELECT date_recolte, ruche_id, type_miel, poids_kg FROM recoltes WHERE strftime('%m', date_recolte) = '07' ORDER BY date_recolte, ruche_id;
SELECT ru.nom, ru.altitude_m, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_ruches FROM ruchers ru LEFT JOIN ruches r ON r.rucher_id = ru.id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.nom, ru.altitude_m ORDER BY nb_ruches DESC, ru.nom, ru.id;

SELECT ru.nom, strftime('%Y', rc.date_recolte) AS annee, COUNT(rc.id) AS nb_recoltes, SUM(rc.poids_kg) AS poids_total_kg FROM recoltes rc JOIN ruches r ON r.id = rc.ruche_id JOIN ruchers ru ON ru.id = r.rucher_id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.nom, annee ORDER BY ru.nom, annee;

SELECT r.nom, ru.nom AS rucher, r.etat, r.date_installation FROM ruches r JOIN ruchers ru ON ru.id = r.rucher_id LEFT JOIN recoltes rc ON rc.ruche_id = r.id WHERE rc.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.date_installation, r.nom, r.id;

SELECT p.nom, SUM(v.nb_pots) AS pots_vendus, ROUND(SUM(v.nb_pots * l.prix_pot), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM points_vente p JOIN ventes v ON v.point_vente_id = p.id JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id GROUP BY p.id, p.nom ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC, p.nom;

SELECT l.numero_lot, l.pots_remplis, COALESCE(SUM(v.nb_pots), 0) AS pots_vendus, l.pots_remplis - COALESCE(SUM(v.nb_pots), 0) AS pots_restants FROM lots l LEFT JOIN ventes v ON v.lot_id = l.id GROUP BY l.id, l.numero_lot, l.pots_remplis HAVING l.pots_remplis - COALESCE(SUM(v.nb_pots), 0) > 0 ORDER BY pots_restants DESC, l.numero_lot;

SELECT CASE WHEN varroa IS NULL THEN 'Non compté' WHEN varroa <= 3 THEN 'Faible' WHEN varroa <= 9 THEN 'Moyen' ELSE 'Fort' END AS niveau, COUNT(*) AS nb_visites FROM visites WHERE date_visite BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY niveau;

SELECT r.nom, r.etat, COUNT(v.id) AS nb_visites, ROUND(AVG(v.force_cadres)) AS force_moyenne FROM ruches r JOIN visites v ON v.ruche_id = r.id WHERE r.etat <> 'Morte' AND v.date_visite BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.id, r.nom, r.etat HAVING AVG(v.force_cadres) < 5 ORDER BY AVG(v.force_cadres), r.nom, r.id;
SELECT r.nom, v.force_cadres, v.reine_vue, v.remarque FROM visites v JOIN ruches r ON r.id = v.ruche_id WHERE v.date_visite = (SELECT MAX(date_visite) FROM visites) ORDER BY r.nom, r.id;

SELECT produit, COUNT(*) AS nb_traitements, ROUND(AVG(julianday(date_fin) - julianday(date_debut)), 1) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM traitements WHERE date_fin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY produit ORDER BY duree_moyenne_jours DESC, produit;

SELECT ru.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.type_miel) AS nb_types, COUNT(rc.id) AS nb_recoltes FROM ruchers ru JOIN ruches r ON r.rucher_id = ru.id JOIN recoltes rc ON rc.ruche_id = r.id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.type_miel) >= 2 ORDER BY ru.nom, ru.id;

WITH t AS (SELECT type_miel, strftime('%Y', date_recolte) AS annee, SUM(poids_kg) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ruche_id) AS rendement FROM recoltes GROUP BY type_miel, annee), e AS (SELECT type_miel, annee, rendement, LAG(rendement) OVER (PARTITION BY type_miel ORDER BY annee) AS rendement_avant FROM t) SELECT type_miel, ROUND(rendement_avant, 2) AS rendement_2024, ROUND(rendement, 2) AS rendement_2025, ROUND(100.0 * (rendement - rendement_avant) / rendement_avant, 1) AS evolution_pct FROM e WHERE annee = '2025' ORDER BY evolution_pct DESC, type_miel;

SELECT ru.nom AS rucher, r.nom AS ruche, SUM(rc.poids_kg) AS kilos_2025, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ru.id ORDER BY SUM(rc.poids_kg) DESC) AS rang FROM ruchers ru JOIN ruches r ON r.rucher_id = ru.id JOIN recoltes rc ON rc.ruche_id = r.id WHERE rc.date_recolte BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY ru.id, ru.nom, r.id, r.nom ORDER BY ru.nom, rang, r.nom, r.id;

WITH mensuel AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', v.date_vente) AS mois, SUM(v.nb_pots * l.prix_pot) AS ca FROM ventes v JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id WHERE v.date_vente BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY mois) SELECT mois, ROUND(ca, 2) AS chiffre_affaires, ROUND(SUM(ca) OVER (ORDER BY mois), 2) AS cumul FROM mensuel ORDER BY mois;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT r.id, r.nom, r.race, SUM(rc.poids_kg) AS total FROM ruches r JOIN recoltes rc ON rc.ruche_id = r.id WHERE r.etat <> 'Morte' GROUP BY r.id, r.nom, r.race), moyennes AS (SELECT race, AVG(total) AS moyenne FROM totaux GROUP BY race) SELECT t.race, t.nom, t.total, ROUND(m.moyenne, 2) AS moyenne_race FROM totaux t JOIN moyennes m ON m.race = t.race WHERE t.total > m.moyenne ORDER BY t.race, t.total DESC, t.nom, t.id;

WITH classees AS (SELECT r.id, r.nom, v.date_visite, v.force_cadres, v.reine_vue, v.varroa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.id ORDER BY v.date_visite DESC) AS rn FROM ruches r JOIN visites v ON v.ruche_id = r.id) SELECT nom, date_visite, force_cadres, reine_vue, varroa FROM classees WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY nom, id;

WITH suivi AS (SELECT r.id, r.nom, v.date_visite, v.force_cadres, LAG(v.force_cadres) OVER (PARTITION BY r.id ORDER BY v.date_visite) AS force_avant FROM ruches r JOIN visites v ON v.ruche_id = r.id) SELECT nom, date_visite, force_avant, force_cadres, force_avant - force_cadres AS perte FROM suivi WHERE force_avant - force_cadres >= 4 ORDER BY date_visite, nom, id;

SELECT p.nom, p.ville FROM points_vente p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lots t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventes v JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id WHERE v.point_vente_id = p.id AND l.type_miel = t.type_miel)) ORDER BY p.nom, p.id;

WITH ca AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', v.date_vente) AS annee_vente, l.type_miel, SUM(v.nb_pots * l.prix_pot) AS montant FROM ventes v JOIN lots l ON l.id = v.lot_id GROUP BY strftime('%Y', v.date_vente), l.type_miel) SELECT annee_vente, type_miel, ROUND(montant, 2) AS chiffre_affaires, ROUND(100.0 * montant / SUM(montant) OVER (PARTITION BY annee_vente), 1) AS part_pct FROM ca ORDER BY annee_vente, part_pct DESC, type_miel;

SELECT p.annee_recolte, p.type_miel, p.contenance_g, g.contenance_g AS contenance_suivante, ROUND(p.prix_pot * 1000.0 / p.contenance_g - g.prix_pot * 1000.0 / g.contenance_g, 2) AS ecart FROM lots p JOIN lots g ON g.type_miel = p.type_miel AND g.annee_recolte = p.annee_recolte AND g.contenance_g > p.contenance_g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lots m WHERE m.type_miel = p.type_miel AND m.annee_recolte = p.annee_recolte AND m.contenance_g > p.contenance_g AND m.contenance_g < g.contenance_g) ORDER BY p.annee_recolte, p.type_miel, p.contenance_g;

SELECT r.nom, ru.nom AS rucher, v.date_visite, v.varroa FROM visites v JOIN ruches r ON r.id = v.ruche_id JOIN ruchers ru ON ru.id = r.rucher_id WHERE v.varroa > 9 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM traitements t WHERE t.ruche_id = v.ruche_id AND t.date_debut BETWEEN v.date_visite AND date(v.date_visite, '+30 days')) ORDER BY v.date_visite, r.nom, r.id;
SELECT nom, duree_max_min, tarif_joueur FROM salles WHERE joueurs_min <= 6 AND joueurs_max >= 6 AND date_ouverture IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tarif_joueur, nom, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, langues FROM maitres_jeu WHERE langues LIKE '%Anglais%' ORDER BY nom, prenom, id;
SELECT p.id, m.prenom, m.nom FROM parties p JOIN maitres_jeu m ON m.id = p.maitre_jeu_id WHERE p.reussie = 0 AND p.indices_demandes = 0 ORDER BY p.id;
SELECT id, temps_secondes, indices_demandes FROM parties WHERE temps_secondes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY temps_secondes, id LIMIT 5;
SELECT nom, LENGTH(nom) AS longueur FROM equipes WHERE LENGTH(nom) > 20 ORDER BY longueur DESC, nom;

SELECT r.date_partie, s.nom, r.creneau, r.nb_joueurs FROM reservations r JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id WHERE strftime('%w', r.date_partie) = '0' AND r.creneau < '12:00' ORDER BY r.date_partie, r.creneau, r.id;
SELECT DISTINCT e.nom, e.email FROM reservations r JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id WHERE r.canal = 'Téléphone' ORDER BY e.nom;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_annulations, SUM(montant_rembourse) AS total_rembourse FROM annulations;
SELECT id, note, commentaire, date_avis FROM avis WHERE note <= 2 ORDER BY note, date_avis, id;
SELECT e.ordre, e.nom, e.type FROM enigmes e JOIN salles s ON s.id = e.salle_id WHERE s.nom = 'Station Orbitale 9' ORDER BY e.ordre;
SELECT m.prenom, m.nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_parties FROM maitres_jeu m LEFT JOIN parties p ON p.maitre_jeu_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.prenom, m.nom ORDER BY nb_parties DESC, m.nom, m.prenom, m.id;

SELECT s.nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_parties, SUM(p.reussie) AS nb_reussies, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(p.reussie) / COUNT(p.id), 1) AS taux_reussite FROM salles s JOIN reservations r ON r.salle_id = s.id JOIN parties p ON p.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY taux_reussite DESC, s.nom, s.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN indices_demandes = 0 THEN 'Aucun indice' WHEN indices_demandes <= 2 THEN '1 ou 2 indices' ELSE '3 indices ou plus' END AS groupe, COUNT(*) AS nb_parties, SUM(reussie) AS nb_reussies FROM parties GROUP BY groupe ORDER BY nb_parties DESC;

SELECT e.nom, r.date_partie, julianday(r.date_partie) - julianday(a.date_annulation) AS jours_avant, a.montant_rembourse FROM annulations a JOIN reservations r ON r.id = a.reservation_id JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id ORDER BY jours_avant, r.date_partie, a.id;

SELECT s.nom, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, COALESCE(SUM(r.prix), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(a.montant_rembourse), 0) AS recette_nette FROM salles s LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.salle_id = s.id LEFT JOIN annulations a ON a.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY recette_nette DESC, s.nom, s.id;

SELECT s.nom, ROUND(AVG(av.note), 2) AS note_moyenne, COUNT(av.id) AS nb_avis FROM avis av JOIN parties p ON p.id = av.partie_id JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom HAVING AVG(av.note) > (SELECT AVG(note) FROM avis) ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC, s.nom;

SELECT e.nom, e.capitaine_prenom, e.capitaine_nom, COUNT(p.id) AS nb_parties FROM equipes e JOIN reservations r ON r.equipe_id = e.id JOIN parties p ON p.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY e.id, e.nom, e.capitaine_prenom, e.capitaine_nom HAVING COUNT(p.id) >= 3 ORDER BY nb_parties DESC, e.nom;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.date_partie) AS mois, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_annulations FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN annulations a ON a.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois;

SELECT r.code_promo, COUNT(*) AS nb_reservations, ROUND(SUM(r.nb_joueurs * s.tarif_joueur - r.prix), 2) AS total_remises FROM reservations r JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id WHERE r.code_promo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.code_promo ORDER BY total_remises DESC;

SELECT e.nom, e.capitaine_prenom, e.capitaine_nom, s.nom AS salle, r.date_partie FROM reservations r JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id LEFT JOIN annulations a ON a.reservation_id = r.id LEFT JOIN parties p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE a.id IS NULL AND p.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.date_partie, r.id;

WITH temps AS (SELECT s.id AS salle_id, s.nom AS salle, e.nom AS equipe, p.temps_secondes, r.date_partie, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY p.temps_secondes) AS rang FROM parties p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id WHERE p.temps_secondes IS NOT NULL) SELECT salle, equipe, temps_secondes, date_partie FROM temps WHERE rang = 1 ORDER BY salle, equipe;

SELECT m.prenom, m.nom, ROUND(AVG(a.note), 2) AS note_moyenne, COUNT(a.id) AS nb_avis, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(a.note) DESC) AS rang FROM maitres_jeu m JOIN parties p ON p.maitre_jeu_id = m.id JOIN avis a ON a.partie_id = p.id GROUP BY m.id, m.prenom, m.nom ORDER BY rang, m.nom, m.prenom;

WITH suite AS (SELECT e.id AS equipe_id, e.nom, r.date_partie, r.creneau, LAG(r.date_partie) OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY r.date_partie, r.creneau) AS date_precedente FROM parties p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id) SELECT nom, date_partie, date_precedente, julianday(date_partie) - julianday(date_precedente) AS nb_jours FROM suite WHERE date_precedente IS NOT NULL AND julianday(date_partie) - julianday(date_precedente) < 30 ORDER BY nom, date_partie, creneau;

WITH par_mois AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.date_partie) AS mois, SUM(r.prix) - COALESCE(SUM(a.montant_rembourse), 0) AS recette FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN annulations a ON a.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.date_partie)) SELECT mois, ROUND(recette, 2) AS recette_nette, ROUND(SUM(recette) OVER (ORDER BY mois), 2) AS recette_cumulee FROM par_mois ORDER BY mois;

WITH ordre_parties AS (SELECT r.equipe_id, r.salle_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.equipe_id ORDER BY r.date_partie, r.creneau) AS numero FROM parties p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id) SELECT s.nom, COUNT(*) AS nb_equipes FROM ordre_parties o JOIN salles s ON s.id = o.salle_id WHERE o.numero = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.nom ORDER BY nb_equipes DESC, s.nom;

SELECT e.nom, e.capitaine_prenom, e.capitaine_nom, e.email FROM equipes e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM salles s WHERE s.date_ouverture IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r JOIN parties p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.equipe_id = e.id AND r.salle_id = s.id)) ORDER BY e.nom;

WITH reussies AS (SELECT s.id AS salle_id, s.nom AS salle, e.nom AS equipe, p.temps_secondes, AVG(p.temps_secondes) OVER (PARTITION BY s.id) AS moyenne FROM parties p JOIN reservations r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN salles s ON s.id = r.salle_id JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id WHERE p.reussie = 1) SELECT salle, equipe, temps_secondes, ROUND(moyenne, 1) AS temps_moyen FROM reussies WHERE temps_secondes < moyenne ORDER BY salle, temps_secondes, equipe;

WITH par_enigme AS (SELECT s.id AS salle_id, s.nom AS salle, en.ordre, en.nom AS enigme, COUNT(i.id) AS nb_indices, SUM(COUNT(i.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.id) AS total_salle FROM indices i JOIN enigmes en ON en.id = i.enigme_id JOIN salles s ON s.id = en.salle_id GROUP BY s.id, s.nom, en.id, en.ordre, en.nom) SELECT salle, enigme, nb_indices, ROUND(100.0 * nb_indices / total_salle, 1) AS part FROM par_enigme WHERE 100.0 * nb_indices / total_salle >= 25 ORDER BY salle, part DESC, ordre;

SELECT e.nom, r1.date_partie, s1.nom AS premiere_salle, r1.creneau AS premier_creneau, s2.nom AS seconde_salle, r2.creneau AS second_creneau FROM reservations r1 JOIN parties p1 ON p1.reservation_id = r1.id JOIN reservations r2 ON r2.equipe_id = r1.equipe_id AND r2.date_partie = r1.date_partie AND r2.creneau > r1.creneau JOIN parties p2 ON p2.reservation_id = r2.id JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r1.equipe_id JOIN salles s1 ON s1.id = r1.salle_id JOIN salles s2 ON s2.id = r2.salle_id ORDER BY r1.date_partie, e.nom;

SELECT e.nom, r.date_reservation, r.date_partie FROM reservations r JOIN equipes e ON e.id = r.equipe_id WHERE r.code_promo = 'FIDELITE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r0 JOIN parties p0 ON p0.reservation_id = r0.id WHERE r0.equipe_id = r.equipe_id AND r0.date_partie <= r.date_reservation) ORDER BY r.date_reservation, r.id;
SELECT nom, genre, pays FROM artistes WHERE cachet IS NULL ORDER BY nom, id;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM festivaliers WHERE date_naissance > '2007-07-04' ORDER BY date_naissance, id;
SELECT nom, cachet FROM artistes ORDER BY cachet DESC, nom LIMIT 3;
SELECT b.prenom, b.nom, b.poste, c.heure_debut, c.heure_fin FROM creneaux c JOIN benevoles b ON b.id = c.benevole_id WHERE c.jour = '2025-07-03' ORDER BY c.heure_debut, b.nom, c.id;
SELECT c.jour, a.nom, c.heure_fin FROM concerts c JOIN artistes a ON a.id = c.artiste_id WHERE c.statut = 'Joué' AND c.heure_fin > '23:00' ORDER BY c.jour, c.heure_fin, c.id;
SELECT DISTINCT ville FROM festivaliers ORDER BY ville;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_pass, SUM(prix) AS recette FROM billets WHERE formule = 'Pass 3 jours';
SELECT f.prenom, f.nom, f.email, b.date_achat FROM billets b JOIN festivaliers f ON f.id = b.festivalier_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', b.date_achat) = '2024-12' ORDER BY b.date_achat, b.id;
SELECT nom, LENGTH(nom) AS nb_caracteres FROM artistes WHERE LENGTH(nom) > 15 ORDER BY nb_caracteres DESC, nom;
SELECT prenom || ' ' || UPPER(nom) AS carte, poste FROM benevoles ORDER BY nom, prenom, id;

SELECT b.prenom, b.nom, b.poste, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_creneaux FROM benevoles b LEFT JOIN creneaux c ON c.benevole_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.prenom, b.nom, b.poste ORDER BY nb_creneaux DESC, b.nom, b.prenom, b.id;

SELECT a.nom, SUM((strftime('%s', c.heure_fin) - strftime('%s', c.heure_debut)) / 60) AS minutes_jouees FROM artistes a JOIN concerts c ON c.artiste_id = a.id WHERE c.statut = 'Joué' GROUP BY a.id, a.nom ORDER BY a.nom, a.id;

SELECT s.nom AS scene, c.jour, a.nom AS artiste, ROUND(100.0 * c.spectateurs / s.jauge, 1) AS taux_remplissage FROM concerts c JOIN scenes s ON s.id = c.scene_id JOIN artistes a ON a.id = c.artiste_id WHERE 100.0 * c.spectateurs / s.jauge >= 90 ORDER BY 100.0 * c.spectateurs / s.jauge DESC, c.jour, c.heure_debut, c.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN date_achat <= '2025-02-28' THEN 'Prévente' ELSE 'Plein tarif' END AS periode, formule, COUNT(*) AS nb_billets, SUM(prix) AS recette FROM billets GROUP BY periode, formule ORDER BY periode, formule;

SELECT f.prenom, f.nom, b.jour AS jour_valable, e.jour AS jour_passage, e.heure FROM entrees e JOIN billets b ON b.id = e.billet_id JOIN festivaliers f ON f.id = b.festivalier_id WHERE b.formule = 'Pass 1 jour' AND e.jour <> b.jour ORDER BY e.jour, e.heure, e.id;

SELECT c.jour, s.nom AS scene, a.nom AS artiste, m.pluie_mm FROM concerts c JOIN scenes s ON s.id = c.scene_id JOIN artistes a ON a.id = c.artiste_id JOIN meteo m ON m.jour = c.jour WHERE c.statut = 'Joué' AND s.type = 'Plein air' AND m.pluie_mm > 0 ORDER BY c.jour, c.heure_debut, c.id;
SELECT f.prenom, f.nom, b.formule FROM billets b JOIN festivaliers f ON f.id = b.festivalier_id WHERE b.date_achat = (SELECT MIN(date_achat) FROM billets) ORDER BY f.nom, f.prenom, b.id;
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS nb_artistes, SUM(COALESCE(cachet, 2000)) AS budget FROM artistes GROUP BY genre ORDER BY budget DESC, genre;
SELECT jour, strftime('%H', heure) AS heure_pleine, COUNT(*) AS nb_passages FROM entrees GROUP BY jour, strftime('%H', heure) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY jour, heure_pleine;

SELECT e.jour, COUNT(*) AS nb_passages, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.formule = 'Pass 3 jours' THEN e.billet_id END) AS nb_pass_3_jours, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.formule = 'Pass 1 jour' THEN e.billet_id END) AS nb_pass_1_jour FROM entrees e JOIN billets b ON b.id = e.billet_id GROUP BY e.jour ORDER BY e.jour;

SELECT g.jour, ag.nom AS artiste_grande_scene, asa.nom AS artiste_saules, (strftime('%s', MIN(g.heure_fin, s.heure_fin)) - strftime('%s', MAX(g.heure_debut, s.heure_debut))) / 60 AS minutes_chevauchement FROM concerts g JOIN scenes sg ON sg.id = g.scene_id JOIN concerts s ON s.jour = g.jour JOIN scenes ss ON ss.id = s.scene_id JOIN artistes ag ON ag.id = g.artiste_id JOIN artistes asa ON asa.id = s.artiste_id WHERE sg.nom = 'Grande Scène' AND ss.nom = 'Scène des Saules' AND g.statut = 'Joué' AND s.statut = 'Joué' AND g.heure_debut < s.heure_fin AND s.heure_debut < g.heure_fin ORDER BY g.jour, g.heure_debut, g.id;

WITH totaux AS (SELECT a.id, a.nom, SUM(c.spectateurs) AS total_spectateurs FROM artistes a JOIN concerts c ON c.artiste_id = a.id WHERE c.statut = 'Joué' GROUP BY a.id, a.nom), classement AS (SELECT id, nom, total_spectateurs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spectateurs DESC) AS rang FROM totaux) SELECT nom, total_spectateurs, rang FROM classement WHERE rang <= 3 ORDER BY rang, nom, id;

WITH ordre AS (SELECT c.jour, s.nom AS scene, a.nom AS artiste, c.heure_debut, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.jour, c.scene_id ORDER BY c.heure_debut) AS numero FROM concerts c JOIN scenes s ON s.id = c.scene_id JOIN artistes a ON a.id = c.artiste_id WHERE c.statut = 'Joué') SELECT jour, scene, artiste, heure_debut FROM ordre WHERE numero = 1 ORDER BY jour, heure_debut;

WITH ventes AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_achat) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nb_billets, SUM(prix) AS recette FROM billets GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_achat)) SELECT mois, nb_billets, recette, SUM(recette) OVER (ORDER BY mois) AS recette_cumulee FROM ventes ORDER BY mois;

WITH suite AS (SELECT c.benevole_id, c.jour, c.heure_debut, LAG(c.heure_fin) OVER (PARTITION BY c.benevole_id, c.jour ORDER BY c.heure_debut) AS fin_precedente FROM creneaux c) SELECT b.prenom, b.nom, s.jour, s.fin_precedente, s.heure_debut, (strftime('%s', s.heure_debut) - strftime('%s', s.fin_precedente)) / 60 AS pause_minutes FROM suite s JOIN benevoles b ON b.id = s.benevole_id WHERE s.fin_precedente IS NOT NULL AND (strftime('%s', s.heure_debut) - strftime('%s', s.fin_precedente)) / 60 < 60 ORDER BY s.jour, s.heure_debut, b.nom;
SELECT genre, nom, cachet, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY cachet DESC) AS niveau FROM artistes WHERE cachet IS NOT NULL ORDER BY genre, niveau, nom;

WITH joues AS (SELECT c.id, c.scene_id, s.nom AS scene, a.nom AS artiste, c.spectateurs FROM concerts c JOIN scenes s ON s.id = c.scene_id JOIN artistes a ON a.id = c.artiste_id WHERE c.statut = 'Joué'), moyennes AS (SELECT scene_id, AVG(spectateurs) AS moyenne FROM joues GROUP BY scene_id) SELECT j.scene, j.artiste, j.spectateurs, ROUND(m.moyenne) AS moyenne_scene FROM joues j JOIN moyennes m ON m.scene_id = j.scene_id WHERE j.spectateurs > m.moyenne ORDER BY j.scene, j.spectateurs DESC, j.artiste, j.id;

WITH jours AS (SELECT DISTINCT jour FROM concerts), valables AS (SELECT j.jour, b.id AS billet_id FROM jours j JOIN billets b ON b.formule = 'Pass 3 jours' OR b.jour = j.jour) SELECT v.jour, COUNT(DISTINCT v.billet_id) AS nb_valables, COUNT(DISTINCT e.billet_id) AS nb_scannes, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT e.billet_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.billet_id), 1) AS taux_presence FROM valables v LEFT JOIN entrees e ON e.billet_id = v.billet_id AND e.jour = v.jour GROUP BY v.jour ORDER BY v.jour;

WITH heures AS (SELECT b.id, b.prenom, b.nom, b.responsable_id, COALESCE(SUM(strftime('%s', c.heure_fin) - strftime('%s', c.heure_debut)), 0) / 3600.0 AS total_heures FROM benevoles b LEFT JOIN creneaux c ON c.benevole_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.prenom, b.nom, b.responsable_id) SELECT h.prenom, h.nom, h.total_heures, r.prenom || ' ' || r.nom AS responsable, r.total_heures AS heures_responsable FROM heures h JOIN heures r ON r.id = h.responsable_id WHERE h.total_heures > r.total_heures ORDER BY h.total_heures DESC, h.nom, h.id;

SELECT b.prenom, b.nom, b.poste FROM benevoles b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jour FROM concerts) j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM creneaux c WHERE c.benevole_id = b.id AND c.jour = j.jour)) ORDER BY b.nom, b.prenom, b.id;

bases.aeroport:
CREATE TABLE passagers (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nationalite    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE         NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE compagnies (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom   VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    pays  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)  NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE avions (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    modele         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    immatriculation VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    capacite       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    compagnie_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (compagnie_id) REFERENCES compagnies(id)
);

CREATE TABLE aeroports (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ville VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    pays  VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)   NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE vols (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    numero_vol          VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    compagnie_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    avion_id            INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    aeroport_depart_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    aeroport_arrivee_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_depart         DATE        NOT NULL,
    heure_depart        TIME        NOT NULL,
    heure_arrivee       TIME        NOT NULL,
    statut              VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (compagnie_id)        REFERENCES compagnies(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (avion_id)            REFERENCES avions(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aeroport_depart_id)  REFERENCES aeroports(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aeroport_arrivee_id) REFERENCES aeroports(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    passager_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    vol_id           INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    classe           VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    siege            VARCHAR(5)   NOT NULL,
    prix             NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    date_reservation DATE         NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (passager_id) REFERENCES passagers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vol_id)      REFERENCES vols(id),
    UNIQUE (vol_id, siege)    -- un siège ne se vend qu’une fois par vol
);

CREATE TABLE bagages (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    poids_kg       NUMERIC(5,2),
    statut         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
);

bases.hopital:
CREATE TABLE services (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    etage         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    capacite_lits INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE medecins (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialite    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL,
    service_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id)
);

CREATE TABLE infirmiers (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    service_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id)
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE        NOT NULL,
    sexe           VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- 'M' ou 'F'
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_admission DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE consultations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    medecin_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_consultation DATE        NOT NULL,
    duree_min         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    diagnostic        VARCHAR(100),      -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medecin_id) REFERENCES medecins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE hospitalisations (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    medecin_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                   -- NULL = hospitalisation en cours
    lit         VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medecin_id) REFERENCES medecins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE prescriptions (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    consultation_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    medicament      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    dosage          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    duree_jours     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (consultation_id) REFERENCES consultations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(150)
);

CREATE TABLE plats (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom          VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    categorie_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix         NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    disponible   BOOLEAN      NOT NULL CHECK (disponible IN (0, 1)), -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (categorie_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    unite     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (unite IN ('kg', 'L', 'pièce')),
    stock     NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    seuil_alerte NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE plats_ingredients (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    plat_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite      NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (plat_id) REFERENCES plats(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(id),
    UNIQUE (plat_id, ingredient_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email       VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    telephone   VARCHAR(20),
    date_inscription DATE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE serveurs (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE       NOT NULL,
    salaire      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tables_resto (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    numero      INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nb_places   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    emplacement VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (emplacement IN ('Salle', 'Terrasse', 'Bar'))
);

CREATE TABLE commandes (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id      INTEGER,           -- nullable : commande sans compte client
    serveur_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    table_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_commande  DATE    NOT NULL,
    heure_commande TIME    NOT NULL,
    nb_personnes   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    statut         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (statut IN ('En cours', 'Servie', 'Payée', 'Annulée')),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (serveur_id) REFERENCES serveurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (table_id)   REFERENCES tables_resto(id)
);

CREATE TABLE lignes_commande (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    plat_id        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    quantite       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (plat_id)     REFERENCES plats(id),
    UNIQUE (commande_id, plat_id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    commande_id  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    note         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire  VARCHAR(255), -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)   REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE especes (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_scientifique VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    nom_commun    VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    classe        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL, -- Mammifère, Oiseau, Reptile, etc.
    regime        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carnivore, Herbivore, Omnivore
    statut_conservation VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL -- LC, NT, VU, EN, CR
);

CREATE TABLE enclos (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    type       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Savane, Jungle, Aquatique, Volière, etc.
    surface_m2 INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    capacite   INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE animaux (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    espece_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    enclos_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE       NOT NULL,
    sexe          VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- M ou F
    poids_kg      NUMERIC(6,2),          -- nullable (pas encore pesé)
    date_arrivee  DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (espece_id) REFERENCES especes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclos_id) REFERENCES enclos(id)
);

CREATE TABLE soigneurs (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialite    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_soigneurs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    soigneur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enclos_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (soigneur_id) REFERENCES soigneurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclos_id)   REFERENCES enclos(id)
);

CREATE TABLE repas (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    soigneur_id INTEGER,               -- nullable : repas automatique
    date_repas  DATE    NOT NULL,
    heure_repas TIME    NOT NULL,
    type_repas  VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,  -- Matin, Midi, Soir
    quantite_kg NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id)   REFERENCES animaux(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (soigneur_id) REFERENCES soigneurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE visiteurs (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE billets (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visiteur_id   INTEGER,             -- nullable : billet anonyme
    date_visite   DATE    NOT NULL,
    type_billet   VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Adulte, Enfant, Étudiant, Senior, Famille
    prix          NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (visiteur_id) REFERENCES visiteurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visiteur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_avis   DATE    NOT NULL,
    note        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire VARCHAR(255),          -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (visiteur_id) REFERENCES visiteurs(id)
);

bases.fromagerie:
CREATE TABLE producteurs (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    region    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    pays      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_creation DATE    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE laits (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type      VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Vache, Chèvre, Brebis, Bufflonne
    origine   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL  -- Fermier, Industriel
);

CREATE TABLE fromages (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    producteur_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    lait_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    type_pate     VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Pâte dure, Pâte molle, Pâte persillée, etc.
    prix_kg       NUMERIC(7,2) NOT NULL,
    disponible    BOOLEAN      NOT NULL, -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (producteur_id) REFERENCES producteurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lait_id)       REFERENCES laits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affinages (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fromage_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duree_jours   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    temperature_c NUMERIC(4,1) NOT NULL,
    humidite_pct  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                  -- NULL = affinage en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id) REFERENCES fromages(id)
);

CREATE TABLE lots (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fromage_id  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    affinage_id INTEGER,                -- nullable : lot non encore affiné
    poids_kg    NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    date_production DATE     NOT NULL,
    numero_lot  VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id)  REFERENCES fromages(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (affinage_id) REFERENCES affinages(id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email      VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE  NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ventes (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id    INTEGER,              -- nullable : vente au comptoir sans compte
    lot_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_vente   DATE         NOT NULL,
    quantite_kg  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    prix_total   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lot_id)    REFERENCES lots(id)
);

CREATE TABLE degustations (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fromage_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_degustation DATE NOT NULL,
    note        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire VARCHAR(255),         -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id) REFERENCES fromages(id)
);

bases.labo:
CREATE TABLE equipes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom         VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    domaine     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Biologie, Chimie, Physique, Informatique, etc.
    date_creation DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE chercheurs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    grade       VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Doctorant, Post-doc, Chargé de recherche, Directeur
    equipe_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipe_id) REFERENCES equipes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE projets (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    titre         VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    equipe_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    budget        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE         NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                   -- NULL = projet en cours
    statut        VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,  -- En cours, Terminé, Suspendu
    FOREIGN KEY (equipe_id) REFERENCES equipes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE experiences (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    projet_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    chercheur_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_experience DATE      NOT NULL,
    duree_heures  NUMERIC(5,1) NOT NULL,
    statut        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- Planifiée, En cours, Terminée
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id)    REFERENCES projets(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (chercheur_id) REFERENCES chercheurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE echantillons (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experience_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    code_echantillon VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    type_echantillon VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Sang, Eau, Roche, Cellules, etc.
    quantite_mg   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    date_prelevement DATE     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (experience_id) REFERENCES experiences(id)
);

CREATE TABLE resultats (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experience_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    mesure        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    valeur        NUMERIC(14,4),          -- nullable : résultat non encore obtenu
    unite         VARCHAR(20),
    date_resultat DATE,                   -- nullable
    valide        BOOLEAN,                -- 1 = validé ; NULL = en attente de validation
    FOREIGN KEY (experience_id) REFERENCES experiences(id)
);

CREATE TABLE publications (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    projet_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    titre         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    revue         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    date_publication DATE,                -- nullable : en préparation
    doi           VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id) REFERENCES projets(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_chercheurs (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    chercheur_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    projet_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                   -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (chercheur_id) REFERENCES chercheurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id)    REFERENCES projets(id)
);

bases.voyages:
CREATE TABLE destinations (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    pays      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    continent VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    climat    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL  -- Tropical, Tempéré, Aride, Polaire
);

CREATE TABLE guides (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    langue        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE circuits (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom            VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    destination_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    duree_jours    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix_base      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    niveau         VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Facile, Modéré, Sportif
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_id) REFERENCES destinations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    circuit_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_reservation DATE        NOT NULL,
    nb_personnes    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    statut          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Confirmée, En attente, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE paiements (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    montant        NUMERIC(9,2) NOT NULL,
    date_paiement  DATE         NOT NULL,
    moyen          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carte, Virement, Espèces, Chèque
    statut         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Payé, En attente, Remboursé
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_guides (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    guide_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    circuit_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (guide_id)   REFERENCES guides(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    circuit_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    note           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire    VARCHAR(255),       -- nullable
    date_avis      DATE    NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

bases.aquarium:
CREATE TABLE aquariologistes (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialite    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE bassins (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom            VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    zone           VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    type_eau       VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    volume_litres  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    temp_min_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    temp_max_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    responsable_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (responsable_id) REFERENCES aquariologistes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE pensionnaires (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    espece       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    categorie    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    bassin_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    effectif     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_arrivee DATE        NOT NULL,
    provenance   VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (bassin_id) REFERENCES bassins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE releves (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    bassin_id         INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_releve       DATE         NOT NULL,
    heure_releve      TIME         NOT NULL,
    temperature_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    ph                DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL,
    salinite_g_l      DECIMAL(5,2),            -- NULL en eau douce
    nitrates_mg_l     DECIMAL(5,2),            -- NULL : mesure non faite
    aquariologiste_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (bassin_id)         REFERENCES bassins(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aquariologiste_id) REFERENCES aquariologistes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE equipements (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type              VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    bassin_id         INTEGER,                 -- NULL : équipement commun
    date_installation DATE        NOT NULL,
    statut            VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,    -- En service, En panne, En maintenance
    FOREIGN KEY (bassin_id) REFERENCES bassins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE interventions (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    equipement_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    type_intervention VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,   -- Panne, Entretien, Remplacement
    date_debut        DATE         NOT NULL,
    date_fin          DATE,                    -- NULL : en cours
    prestataire       VARCHAR(60),             -- NULL : équipe interne
    cout              DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL,
    description       VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipement_id) REFERENCES equipements(id)
);

CREATE TABLE animations (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom        VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    bassin_id  INTEGER,                        -- NULL : pas devant un bassin
    duree_min  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    capacite   INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix_eleve DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (bassin_id) REFERENCES bassins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animation_id       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    etablissement      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    ville              VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    niveau             VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    date_animation     DATE        NOT NULL,
    heure_debut        TIME        NOT NULL,
    nb_eleves          INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    nb_accompagnateurs INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    statut             VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- Confirmée, En attente, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (animation_id) REFERENCES animations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE salles (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom            VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    theme          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Aventure, Braquage, Enquête, Épouvante, Famille, Science-fiction
    difficulte     INTEGER      NOT NULL CHECK (difficulte BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    duree_max_min  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    joueurs_min    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    joueurs_max    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    tarif_joueur   DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    date_ouverture DATE                   -- NULL : salle pas encore ouverte
);

CREATE TABLE enigmes (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    salle_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    ordre    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    nom      VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    type     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- Cadenas, Fouille, Logique, Manipulation, Observation
    FOREIGN KEY (salle_id) REFERENCES salles(id),
    UNIQUE (salle_id, ordre)
);

CREATE TABLE maitres_jeu (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE         NOT NULL,
    langues       VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE equipes (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom              VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    type_groupe      VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Amis, Entreprise, Famille
    ville            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    capitaine_prenom VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    capitaine_nom    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    email            VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    equipe_id        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    salle_id         INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_partie      DATE         NOT NULL,
    creneau          TIME         NOT NULL,
    nb_joueurs       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix             DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
    canal            VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Site web, Téléphone, Sur place
    date_reservation DATE         NOT NULL,
    code_promo       VARCHAR(20),           -- NULL : aucun code
    FOREIGN KEY (equipe_id) REFERENCES equipes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (salle_id)  REFERENCES salles(id)
);

CREATE TABLE annulations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    date_annulation   DATE         NOT NULL,
    motif             VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Empêchement, Groupe incomplet, Maladie, Météo
    montant_rembourse DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE parties (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    maitre_jeu_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reussie          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reussie IN (0, 1)),
    temps_secondes   INTEGER,             -- NULL : l’équipe n’est pas sortie à temps
    indices_demandes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (maitre_jeu_id)  REFERENCES maitres_jeu(id)
);

CREATE TABLE indices (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    partie_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enigme_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minute    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (partie_id) REFERENCES parties(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enigme_id) REFERENCES enigmes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    partie_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    date_avis   DATE    NOT NULL,
    note        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire VARCHAR(255),          -- NULL : une note sans commentaire
    FOREIGN KEY (partie_id) REFERENCES parties(id)
);

schema:
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
/* Schema pedagogique : clients, produits, commandes, et fidelite
   (une fiche de points par client : relation 1-1, lecon relations 1-1, 1-N et N-N). */
CREATE TABLE clients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  prenom TEXT NOT NULL,
  nom TEXT,
  adresse TEXT,
  ville TEXT,
  age INTEGER CHECK (age >= 0),
  email TEXT UNIQUE,
  telephone TEXT,
  date_inscription TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE produits (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  nom TEXT NOT NULL,
  categorie TEXT,
  prix REAL,
  stock INTEGER CHECK (stock >= 0)
);
CREATE TABLE commandes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  numero_commande TEXT,
  client_id INTEGER,
  produit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantite INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantite > 0),
  date_commande TEXT,
  statut TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_preparation',
  FOREIGN KEY (client_id)
    REFERENCES clients(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (produit_id)
    REFERENCES produits(id)
);
